translations.idiomatic: He also said the Jurchens would certainly perish, and that ruler and subject alike ought to take praying to Heaven for an enduring mandate as their guiding principle.

sentences.zh: 充金國賀登位使，及盱眙，聞金人內變而返。

translations.literal: Appointed envoy to congratulate Jin on the new accession; when he reached Xuyi he heard of internal turmoil among the Jurchens and returned.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed envoy to congratulate Jin on the new accession. When he reached Xuyi he heard of internal turmoil among the Jurchens and returned.

sentences.zh: 言於上曰：“臣自揚之楚，自楚之盱眙，沃壤無際，陂湖相連，民皆堅悍強忍，此天賜吾國以屏障大江，使強兵足食為進取資。

translations.literal: He said to the emperor: "Your servant, from Yang to Chu, from Chu to Xuyi—fertile soil without end, marshes and lakes connected—the people are all staunch, fierce, and enduring. Heaven has given our state the Great River as a barrier, that strong soldiers may have full provisions as resources for advance.
translations.idiomatic: He said to the emperor: "Your servant traveled from Yang to Chu, from Chu to Xuyi. Fertile soil stretched without end, marshes and lakes connected. The people are staunch, fierce, and enduring. Heaven has given our state the Great River as a barrier so that strong soldiers may have full provisions as resources for advance.

sentences.zh: 顧田疇不辟，溝洫不治，險要不扼，丁壯不練，豪傑武勇不收拾，一旦有警，則徒以長江為恃。

translations.literal: Yet fields are not opened, ditches not maintained, strategic points not held, able-bodied men not trained, heroes and the martial brave not gathered—once alarm comes, we can only rely on the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: Yet fields are not opened, ditches not maintained, strategic points not held, able-bodied men not trained, and heroes and the martial brave not gathered. Once alarm comes, we can only rely on the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 豈如及今大修墾田之政，專為一司以領之，數年之後，積儲充實，邊民父子爭欲自保，因其什伍，勒以兵法，不待糧餉，皆為精兵。

translations.literal: Would it not be better to greatly repair the policy of reclaiming fields now, establish a single bureau to oversee it—after several years stores are full, frontier people fathers and sons all struggle to protect themselves, organizing them in groups of five and ten, driving them with military law—without waiting for rations, all become crack troops.
translations.idiomatic: Would it not be better to greatly repair the policy of reclaiming fields now and establish a single bureau to oversee it? After several years stores would be full, frontier people fathers and sons would struggle to protect themselves, and organizing them in groups of five and ten and driving them with military law, without waiting for rations, all would become crack troops.

sentences.zh: ”又言邊防要事。

translations.literal: " He also spoke of important frontier matters.
translations.idiomatic: He also spoke of important frontier matters.

sentences.zh: 時史彌遠方以爵祿縻天下士，德秀慨然謂劉爚曰：“吾徒須急引去，使廟堂知世亦有不肯為從官之人。

translations.literal: At the time Shi Miyuan was using rank and salary to tether men of talent under Heaven. Dexiu said with feeling to Liu Yan: "We must quickly withdraw, to let the court know that in the world there are also men unwilling to serve as attendant officials.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Shi Miyuan was using rank and salary to tether men of talent throughout the realm. Dexiu said with feeling to Liu Yan: "We must quickly withdraw, to let the court know that in the world there are also men unwilling to serve as attendant officials.

sentences.zh: ”遂力請去，出為秘閣修撰、江東轉運副使。

translations.literal: " He then forcefully requested departure and was sent out as Compiler of the Hall of Secret Relics and Deputy Transport Commissioner of Jiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He then forcefully requested departure and was sent out as Compiler of the Hall of Secret Relics and Deputy Transport Commissioner of Jiangdong.

sentences.zh: 山東盜起，朝廷猶與金通聘，德秀朝辭，奏：“國恥不可忘，鄰盜不可輕，幸安之謀不可恃，導諛之言不可聽，至公之論不可忽。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Shandong; the court still exchanged envoys with Jin. At his farewell audience Dexiu memorialized: "National humiliation must not be forgotten, neighboring bandits must not be slighted, plans for fortunate peace must not be relied on, words that guide flattery must not be heeded, utterly public opinion must not be neglected.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Shandong, yet the court still exchanged envoys with Jin. At his farewell audience Dexiu memorialized: "National humiliation must not be forgotten, neighboring bandits must not be slighted, plans for fortunate peace must not be relied on, words that guide flattery must not be heeded, and utterly public opinion must not be neglected.

sentences.zh: ”寧宗曰：“卿力有餘，到江東日為朕撙節財計，以助邊用。

translations.literal: " Emperor Ningzong said: "You have strength to spare. When you reach Jiangdong, daily economize finances for Us, to assist frontier expenditures.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ningzong said: "You have strength to spare. When you reach Jiangdong, daily economize finances for Us to assist frontier expenditures.

sentences.zh: 江東旱蝗，廣德、太平為甚，德秀遂與留守、憲司分所部九郡大講荒政，而自領廣德、太平。

translations.literal: Jiangdong suffered drought and locusts; Guangde and Taiping were worst. Dexiu together with the Military Commissioner and Judicial Commissioner divided the nine prefectures under them to vigorously implement famine relief, while personally taking charge of Guangde and Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangdong suffered drought and locusts; Guangde and Taiping were worst affected. Dexiu together with the Military Commissioner and Judicial Commissioner divided the nine prefectures under them to vigorously implement famine relief, while personally taking charge of Guangde and Taiping.

sentences.zh: 親至廣德，與太守魏峴同以便宜發廩，使教授林庠振給，竣事而還。

translations.literal: He personally went to Guangde, and together with Prefect Wei Xian used discretionary authority to open granaries, had Instructor Lin Xiang distribute relief; when finished he returned.
translations.idiomatic: He personally went to Guangde, and together with Prefect Wei Xian used discretionary authority to open granaries and had Instructor Lin Xiang distribute relief. When the work was finished he returned.

sentences.zh: 百姓數千人送之郊外，指道傍叢塚泣曰：“此皆往歲餓死者。

translations.literal: Several thousand common people escorted him to the outskirts of the city, pointing to tomb mounds by the road and weeping: "These are all those who starved to death in past years.
translations.idiomatic: Several thousand common people escorted him to the outskirts of the city, pointing to tomb mounds by the road and weeping: "These are all those who starved to death in past years.

sentences.zh: 微公，我輩已相隨入此矣。

translations.literal: But for you, sir, we would already have followed one another into this place.
translations.idiomatic: But for you, sir, we would already have followed one another into this place.

sentences.zh: ”索毀太平州私創之大斛。

translations.literal: " He demanded destruction of the privately created large measuring bushel in Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He demanded destruction of the privately created large measuring bushel in Taiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 新徽州守林琰無廉聲，寧國守張忠恕私匿振濟米，皆劾之，而以李道傳攝徽。

translations.literal: The new prefect of Huizhou Lin Yan had no reputation for integrity; the prefect of Ningguo Zhang Zhongshu privately hoarded relief grain—he impeached both and had Li Daochuan act as prefect of Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The new prefect of Huizhou, Lin Yan, had no reputation for integrity; the prefect of Ningguo, Zhang Zhongshu, privately hoarded relief grain. Dexiu impeached both and had Li Daochuan act as prefect of Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 先是，都司胡貙、薛拯每誚德秀迂儒，試以事必敗，至是政譽日聞，因倡言旱傷本輕，監司好名，振贍太過，使峴劾庠以撼德秀。

translations.literal: Previously Capital Bureau officers Hu Chi and Xue Cheng often mocked Dexiu as an impractical scholar, trying matters certain to fail; now his reputation for governance grew daily, so they advocated that drought damage was originally slight, the commissioners sought fame, and relief was excessive—they had Wei Xian impeach Lin Xiang to shake Dexiu.
translations.idiomatic: Previously Capital Bureau officers Hu Chi and Xue Cheng had often mocked Dexiu as an impractical scholar and tried matters certain to fail. Now his reputation for governance grew daily, so they advocated that drought damage was originally slight, the commissioners sought fame, and relief was excessive. They had Wei Xian impeach Lin Xiang to shake Dexiu.

sentences.zh: 德秀上章自明，朝廷悟，與峴祠，授庠幹官，而道傳尋亦召還。

translations.literal: Dexiu submitted a memorial clarifying himself; the court understood, gave Wei Xian a sinecure, appointed Lin Xiang a staff officer, and Li Daochuan was soon also recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Dexiu submitted a memorial clarifying himself. The court understood, gave Wei Xian a sinecure, appointed Lin Xiang a staff officer, and Li Daochuan was soon also recalled.

sentences.zh: 德秀以右文殿修撰知泉州。

translations.literal: Dexiu was appointed Compiler of the Hall of Right Culture and prefect of Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Dexiu was appointed Compiler of the Hall of Right Culture and prefect of Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 番舶畏苛征，至者歲不三四，德秀首寬之，至者驟增至三十六艘。

translations.literal: Foreign ships feared harsh levies; arrivals were only three or four a year. Dexiu first eased them; arrivals suddenly increased to thirty-six vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign ships feared harsh levies; only three or four arrived each year. Dexiu first eased the levies, and arrivals suddenly increased to thirty-six vessels.

sentences.zh: 輸租令民自概，聽訟惟揭示姓名，人自詣州。

translations.literal: For rent payment he had the people measure grain themselves; for hearing lawsuits he only posted names and people came to the prefecture on their own.
translations.idiomatic: For rent payment he had the people measure grain themselves. For hearing lawsuits he only posted names, and people came to the prefecture on their own.

sentences.zh: 泉多大家，為閭裏患，痛繩之。

translations.literal: Quanzhou had many powerful families who were a scourge to neighborhoods; he strictly punished them.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhou had many powerful families who were a scourge to their neighborhoods; he strictly punished them.

sentences.zh: 有訟田者，至焚其券不敢爭。

translations.literal: Some who sued over land burned their deeds rather than contest.
translations.idiomatic: Some who sued over land burned their deeds rather than contest.

sentences.zh: 海賊作亂，將逼城，官軍敗衄，德秀祭兵死者，乃親授方略，禽之。

translations.literal: Sea bandits rebelled and were about to threaten the city; government troops were defeated. Dexiu sacrificed to the dead soldiers, then personally handed down strategy and captured them.
translations.idiomatic: Sea bandits rebelled and were about to threaten the city. Government troops were defeated. Dexiu sacrificed to the dead soldiers, then personally handed down strategy and captured the bandits.

sentences.zh: 復遍行海濱，審視形勢，增屯要害處，以備不虞。

translations.literal: He again traveled throughout the coast, examined terrain, and increased garrisons at strategic points to guard against the unexpected.
translations.idiomatic: He again traveled throughout the coast, examined the terrain, and increased garrisons at strategic points to guard against the unexpected.

sentences.zh: 十二年，以集英殿修撰知隆興府。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was appointed Compiler of the Hall for Gathering Eminence and prefect of Longxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was appointed Compiler of the Hall for Gathering Eminence and prefect of Longxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 承寬弛之後，乃稍濟以嚴。

translations.literal: After lenient laxity, he slightly tempered it with strictness.
translations.idiomatic: After lenient laxity, he slightly tempered governance with strictness.

sentences.zh: 尤留意軍政，欲分鄂州軍屯武昌，及通廣鹽於贛與南安，以弭汀、贛鹽寇。

translations.literal: He especially attended to military administration, wished to divide Ezhou troops to garrison Wuchang, and extend Guang salt to Gan and Nan'an to pacify the salt bandits of Ting and Gan.
translations.idiomatic: He especially attended to military administration, wished to divide Ezhou troops to garrison Wuchang, and extend Guang salt to Gan and Nan'an to pacify the salt bandits of Ting and Gan.

sentences.zh: 未及行，以母喪歸。

translations.literal: Before this could be carried out, he returned home on his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: Before this could be carried out, he returned home on his mother's death.

sentences.zh: 明年，蘄、黃失守，盜起南安，討之數載始平，人服德秀先見。

translations.literal: The next year Qi and Huang fell; bandits rose in Nan'an; suppressing them took several years before peace. People admired Dexiu's foresight.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Qi and Huang fell, bandits rose in Nan'an, and suppressing them took several years before peace was restored. People admired Dexiu's foresight.

sentences.zh: 十五年，以寶謨閣待制、湖南安撫使知潭州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was appointed Awaiting Orders at the Hall of Treasured Plans, Pacification Commissioner of Hunan, and prefect of Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was appointed Awaiting Orders at the Hall of Treasured Plans, Pacification Commissioner of Hunan, and prefect of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 以“廉仁功勤”四字勵僚屬，以周惇頤、胡安國、朱熹、張栻學術源流勉其士。

translations.literal: With the four characters "Integrity, Benevolence, Merit, Diligence" he encouraged his staff; with the academic lineage of Zhou Dunyi, Hu Anguo, Zhu Xi, and Zhang Shi he exhorted his scholars.
translations.idiomatic: With the four characters "Integrity, Benevolence, Merit, Diligence" he encouraged his staff, and with the academic lineage of Zhou Dunyi, Hu Anguo, Zhu Xi, and Zhang Shi he exhorted his scholars.

sentences.zh: 罷榷酤，除斛麵米，申免和糴，以甦其民。

translations.literal: He abolished the salt monopoly, removed the surcharge on rice measured by the bushel, petitioned exemption from compulsory grain purchase, to revive the people.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished the salt monopoly, removed the surcharge on rice measured by the bushel, and petitioned exemption from compulsory grain purchase to revive the people.

sentences.zh: 民艱食，既極力振贍之，復立惠民倉五萬石，使歲出糶。

translations.literal: The people had difficulty obtaining food; having exerted utmost strength in relief, he also established a Beneficial People Granary of fifty thousand shi, having it sell grain annually.
translations.idiomatic: The people had difficulty obtaining food. Having exerted utmost strength in relief, he also established a Beneficial People Granary of fifty thousand shi and had it sell grain annually.

sentences.zh: 又易穀九萬五千石，分十二縣置社倉，以遍及鄉落。

translations.literal: He also exchanged ninety-five thousand shi of grain, establishing community granaries in twelve counties to extend coverage to villages.
translations.idiomatic: He also exchanged ninety-five thousand shi of grain and established community granaries in twelve counties to extend coverage to villages.

sentences.zh: 別立慈幼倉立義阡。

translations.literal: He separately established a Caring for Infants Granary and a public burial ground.
translations.idiomatic: He separately established a Caring for Infants Granary and a public burial ground.

sentences.zh: 惠政畢舉。

translations.literal: Beneficent policies were fully implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Beneficent policies were fully implemented.

sentences.zh: 月試諸軍射，捐其回易之利及官田租。

translations.literal: Monthly he tested the troops in archery, donating profits from their trading and official field rents.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly he tested the troops in archery, donating profits from their trading and official field rents.

sentences.zh: 凡營中病者、死未葬者、孕者、嫁娶者，贍給有差。

translations.literal: For those sick in camp, dead but not yet buried, pregnant, or marrying—support was given in gradations.
translations.idiomatic: For those sick in camp, dead but not yet buried, pregnant, or marrying, support was given in gradations.

sentences.zh: 朝廷從壽昌朱橐請，以飛虎軍戍壽昌，並致其家口，力爭止之。

translations.literal: The court, acceding to Zhu Nuo of Shouchang's request, would garrison the Flying Tiger Army at Shouchang and bring their families; Dexiu forcefully argued to stop it.
translations.idiomatic: The court, acceding to Zhu Nuo of Shouchang's request, would garrison the Flying Tiger Army at Shouchang and bring their families. Dexiu forcefully argued to stop it.

sentences.zh: 江華縣賊蘇師入境殺劫，檄廣西共討平之。

translations.literal: The bandit Su Shi of Jianghua entered the territory to kill and plunder; he dispatched Guangxi to jointly suppress and pacify him.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit Su Shi of Jianghua entered the territory to kill and plunder. Dexiu dispatched Guangxi to jointly suppress and pacify him.

sentences.zh: 司馬遵守武岡，激軍變，劾遵而誅其亂者。

translations.literal: Sima Zun governed Wugang, incited a military mutiny; Dexiu impeached Zun and executed the mutineers.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Zun governed Wugang and incited a military mutiny. Dexiu impeached Zun and executed the mutineers.

sentences.zh: 理宗即位，召為中書舍人，尋擢禮部侍郎、直學士院。

translations.literal: When Emperor Lizong ascended, Dexiu was summoned as Drafting Secretary of the Central Secretariat, soon promoted to Vice Minister of Rites and duty officer of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Lizong ascended, Dexiu was summoned as Drafting Secretary of the Central Secretariat and soon promoted to Vice Minister of Rites and duty officer of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 入見，奏：“三綱五常，扶持宇宙之棟幹，奠安生民之柱石。

translations.literal: Entering audience he memorialized: "The Three Bonds and Five Constants are the beams that uphold the cosmos and the pillars that settle the people.
translations.idiomatic: Entering audience he memorialized: "The Three Bonds and Five Constants are the beams that uphold the cosmos and the pillars that settle the people.

sentences.zh: 晉廢三綱而劉、石之變興，唐廢三綱而安祿山之難作。

translations.literal: Jin abolished the Three Bonds and the disorders of Liu and Shi arose; Tang abolished the Three Bonds and An Lushan's catastrophe occurred.
translations.idiomatic: Jin abolished the Three Bonds and the disorders of Liu and Shi arose. Tang abolished the Three Bonds and An Lushan's catastrophe occurred.

sentences.zh: 我朝立國，先正名分。

translations.literal: Our dynasty founded the state, first rectifying names and ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty founded the state by first rectifying names and ranks.

sentences.zh: 陛下不幸處人倫之變，流聞四方，所損非淺。

translations.literal: Your Majesty has unfortunately been placed in a change of human relations; it has circulated to the four quarters; the harm is not slight.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has unfortunately been placed in a change of human relations. It has circulated to the four quarters, and the harm is not slight.

sentences.zh: 霅川之變，非濟王本誌，前有避匿之跡，後聞討捕之謀，情狀本末，灼然可考。

translations.literal: The Zhaochuan affair was not Prince Ji's original intent; before there were traces of hiding and evasion, afterward came word of pursuit and capture—the circumstances from beginning to end are clearly traceable.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhaochuan affair was not Prince Ji's original intent. Before there were traces of hiding and evasion; afterward came word of pursuit and capture. The circumstances from beginning to end are clearly traceable.

sentences.zh: 願討論雍熙追封秦王舍罪恤孤故事，濟王未有子息，亦惟陛下興滅繼絕。

translations.literal: I wish to discuss the precedent of Yongxi when the Qin Prince was posthumously ennobled, faults pardoned, and orphans consoled. Prince Ji has no offspring; may Your Majesty also revive what is extinguished and continue what is broken.
translations.idiomatic: I wish to discuss the precedent of Yongxi, when the Qin Prince was posthumously ennobled, faults pardoned, and orphans consoled. Prince Ji has no offspring; may Your Majesty also revive what is extinguished and continue what is broken.

sentences.zh: ”上曰：“朝廷待濟王亦至矣。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "The court's treatment of Prince Ji has also been thorough.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "The court's treatment of Prince Ji has also been thorough.

sentences.zh: ”德秀曰：“若謂此事處置盡善，臣未敢以為然。

translations.literal: " Dexiu said: "If one says this matter was handled entirely well, your servant does not dare think so.
translations.idiomatic: Dexiu said: "If one says this matter was handled entirely well, your servant does not dare think so.

sentences.zh: 觀舜所以處象，則陛下不及舜明甚。

translations.literal: Considering how Shun dealt with Xiang, Your Majesty falls far short of Shun's wisdom.
translations.idiomatic: Considering how Shun dealt with Xiang, Your Majesty falls far short of Shun's wisdom.

sentences.zh: 人主但當以二帝、三王為師。

translations.literal: A ruler ought only take the Two Emperors and Three Kings as teachers.
translations.idiomatic: A ruler ought only take the Two Emperors and Three Kings as teachers.

sentences.zh: ”上曰：“一時倉猝耳。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "It was a moment of haste.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "It was a moment of haste.

sentences.zh: ”德秀曰：“此已往之咎，惟願陛下知有此失而益講學進德。

translations.literal: " Dexiu said: "This is past fault; I only wish Your Majesty to know there was this failing and further exert yourself in study and advancing virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Dexiu said: "This is past fault. I only wish Your Majesty to know there was this failing and further exert yourself in study and advancing virtue.

sentences.zh: ”次言：“霅川之獄，未聞參聽於公朝，淮、蜀二閫乃出於僉論所期之外。

translations.literal: " Next he said: "In the Zhaochuan case, I have not heard joint deliberation in the open court; the appointments of the two frontier commanders of Huai and Shu came entirely outside what public consensus expected.
translations.idiomatic: Next he said: "In the Zhaochuan case, I have not heard joint deliberation in the open court. The appointments of the two frontier commanders of Huai and Shu came entirely outside what public consensus expected.

sentences.zh: 天下之事非一家之私，何惜不與眾共之？

translations.literal: Affairs under Heaven are not the private concern of one house—why be reluctant to share them with all?
translations.idiomatic: Affairs under Heaven are not the private concern of one house. Why be reluctant to share them with all?

sentences.zh: ” 且言：“乾道、淳熙間，有位於朝者以饋及門為恥，受任於外者以包苴入都為羞。

translations.literal: " He also said: "Between the Qiandao and Chunxi eras, those in office at court were ashamed when gifts reached their doors; those appointed outside were ashamed to bring bribes to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Between the Qiandao and Chunxi eras, those in office at court were ashamed when gifts reached their doors, and those appointed outside were ashamed to bring bribes to the capital.

sentences.zh: 今饋賂公行，薰染成風，恬不知怪。

translations.literal: Now gifts and bribes proceed openly, corruption has become custom, and people calmly do not find it strange.
translations.idiomatic: Now gifts and bribes proceed openly, corruption has become custom, and people calmly do not find it strange.

sentences.zh: ”又疏言：“朝廷之上，敏銳之士多於老成，雖嚐以耆艾褒傅伯成、楊簡，以儒學褒柴中行，以恬退用趙蕃、劉宰，至忠亮敢言如陳宓、徐僑，皆未蒙錄用。

translations.literal: " He also submitted a memorial: "At court, keen-minded men outnumber seasoned veterans. Though Fu Bocheng and Yang Jian were once praised for aged virtue, Chai Zhonghang for Confucian learning, Zhao Fan and Liu Zai employed for quiet withdrawal—yet loyal and upright men who dare speak, such as Chen Mi and Xu Qiao, have all not received appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He also submitted a memorial: "At court, keen-minded men outnumber seasoned veterans. Though Fu Bocheng and Yang Jian were once praised for aged virtue, Chai Zhonghang for Confucian learning, and Zhao Fan and Liu Zai employed for quiet withdrawal, loyal and upright men who dare speak, such as Chen Mi and Xu Qiao, have all not received appointment.

sentences.zh: ”上問謙吏，德秀以知袁州趙{政}夫對，親擢 {政}夫直秘閣、為監司。

translations.literal: " The emperor asked about upright officials; Dexiu answered with Zhao Bianfu, prefect of Yuanzhou; the emperor personally promoted Zhao Bianfu to Direct Attendant at the Hall of Secret Classics and made him a supervisory commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked about upright officials. Dexiu answered with Zhao Bianfu, prefect of Yuanzhou. The emperor personally promoted Zhao Bianfu to Direct Attendant at the Hall of Secret Classics and made him a supervisory commissioner.

sentences.zh: 具手劄入謝，因言崔與之帥蜀，楊長儒帥閩，皆有廉聲，乞廣加谘訪。

translations.literal: He submitted a handwritten note entering to give thanks, and spoke of Cui Yuzhi commanding Shu and Yang Changru commanding Min—both had reputations for integrity—begging broad inquiry and consultation.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a handwritten note to give thanks and spoke of Cui Yuzhi commanding Shu and Yang Changru commanding Min—both had reputations for integrity—begging broad inquiry and consultation.

sentences.zh: 上初禦清暑殿，德秀因經筵侍上，進曰：“此高、孝二祖儲神燕閑之地，仰瞻楹桷，當如二祖實臨其上。

translations.literal: When the emperor first attended court at the Clear Summer Hall, Dexiu as lecturer attended the emperor and advanced, saying: "This is the place where the two ancestors Gaozong and Xiaozong stored their spirits and passed leisure; looking up at the pillars and rafters, one ought to feel as if the two ancestors truly preside above.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor first attended court at the Clear Summer Hall, Dexiu as lecturer attended the emperor and advanced, saying: "This is the place where the two ancestors Gaozong and Xiaozong stored their spirits and passed leisure. Looking up at the pillars and rafters, one ought to feel as if the two ancestors truly preside above.

sentences.zh: 陛下所居處密邇東朝，未敢遽當人主之奉。

translations.literal: The place where Your Majesty dwells is close to the Eastern Palace; I do not yet dare hastily accept the support due a ruler.
translations.idiomatic: The place where Your Majesty dwells is close to the Eastern Palace. I do not yet dare hastily accept the support due a ruler.

sentences.zh: 今宮閣之義浸備，以一心而受眾攻，未有不浸淫而蠹蝕者，惟學可以明此心，惟敬可以存此心，惟親君子可以維持此心。

translations.literal: Now the meaning of palace halls is gradually complete; with one mind assailed on many sides, there is none that does not gradually spread and corrode—only learning can clarify this mind, only reverence can preserve this mind, only keeping close to gentlemen can sustain this mind.
translations.idiomatic: Now the meaning of palace halls is gradually complete. With one mind assailed on many sides, there is none that does not gradually spread and corrode. Only learning can clarify this mind, only reverence can preserve this mind, and only keeping close to gentlemen can sustain this mind.

sentences.zh: ”因極陳古者居喪之法與先帝視朝之勤。

translations.literal: " He then exhaustively set forth ancient methods of mourning and the former emperor's diligence in holding court.
translations.idiomatic: He then exhaustively set forth ancient methods of mourning and the former emperor's diligence in holding court.

sentences.zh: 寧宗小祥，詔群臣服純吉，德秀爭之曰：“自漢文帝率情變古，惟我孝宗方衰服三年，朝衣朝冠皆以大布，惜當時不並定臣下執喪之禮，此千載無窮之憾。

translations.literal: At Emperor Ningzong's xiao xiang, an edict ordered the ministers to wear pure auspicious dress. Dexiu contested: "Since Emperor Wen of Han changed the ancient rites by following emotion, only our Emperor Xiaozong wore mourning for three years; court robes and caps were all of coarse cloth—it is a pity that at the time the rites for ministers observing mourning were not also fixed; this is a regret without end for a thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: At Emperor Ningzong's xiao xiang, an edict ordered the ministers to wear pure auspicious dress. Dexiu contested: "Since Emperor Wen of Han changed the ancient rites by following emotion, only our Emperor Xiaozong wore mourning for three years. Court robes and caps were all of coarse cloth. It is a pity that at the time the rites for ministers observing mourning were not also fixed. This is a regret without end for a thousand years.

sentences.zh: 孝宗崩，從臣羅點等議，令群臣易月之後，未釋衰服，惟朝會治事權用黑帶公服，時序仍臨慰，至大祥始除。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaozong died, attendant ministers Luo Dian and others deliberated: after ministers changed dress at one month, they did not yet remove mourning garments; only for court assembly and handling affairs they provisionally used black-belt official dress; on seasonal occasions they still paid condolence visits; only at da xiang did they remove mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozong died, attendant ministers Luo Dian and others deliberated that after ministers changed dress at one month, they did not yet remove mourning garments. Only for court assembly and handling affairs they provisionally used black-belt official dress. On seasonal occasions they still paid condolence visits. Only at da xiang did they remove mourning.

sentences.zh: 侂胄枋政，始以小祥從吉。

translations.literal: When Tuozhou held power, they first followed auspicious dress at xiao xiang.
translations.idiomatic: When Tuozhou held power, they first followed auspicious dress at xiao xiang.

sentences.zh: 且帶不以金，鞓不以紅，佩不以魚，鞍轎不以文繡。

translations.literal: Moreover belts were not of gold, girdles not red, pendants not fish, saddles and palanquins not embroidered.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover belts were not of gold, girdles not red, pendants not fish, and saddles and palanquins not embroidered.

sentences.zh: 此於群臣何損？

translations.literal: What harm would this do to the ministers?
translations.idiomatic: What harm would this do to the ministers?

sentences.zh: 朝儀何傷？

translations.literal: What injury to court ceremony?
translations.idiomatic: What injury to court ceremony?

sentences.zh: ”議遂格。

translations.literal: " The proposal was then blocked.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was then blocked.

sentences.zh: 德秀屢進鯁言，上皆虛心開納，而彌遠益嚴憚之，乃謀所以相撼，畏公議，未敢發。

translations.literal: Dexiu repeatedly offered blunt words; the emperor all opened his mind and accepted, yet Miyuan feared him more and more, and plotted how to shake him—fearing public opinion, he did not yet dare act.
translations.idiomatic: Dexiu repeatedly offered blunt words, and the emperor opened his mind and accepted them all. Yet Miyuan feared him more and more and plotted how to shake him. Fearing public opinion, he did not yet dare act.

sentences.zh: 給事中王塈、盛章始駁德秀所主濟王贈典，繼而殿中侍御史莫澤劾之，遂以煥章閣待制提舉玉隆宮。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretaries Wang Xi and Sheng Zhang first rebutted the posthumous honors for Prince Ji that Dexiu had advocated; then Palace Censor Mo Ze impeached him; he was demoted to Awaiting Orders at the Hall of Resplendent Chapters, charged with the Jade Ascent Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretaries Wang Xi and Sheng Zhang first rebutted the posthumous honors for Prince Ji that Dexiu had advocated. Then Palace Censor Mo Ze impeached him, and he was demoted to Awaiting Orders at the Hall of Resplendent Chapters, charged with the Jade Ascent Palace.

sentences.zh: 諫議大夫朱端常又劾之，落職罷祠。

translations.literal: Remonstrance Grandee Zhu Duanchang again impeached him; he was stripped of office and lost his sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance Grandee Zhu Duanchang again impeached him, and he was stripped of office and lost his sinecure.

sentences.zh: 監察御史梁成大又劾之，請加竄殛。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Liang Chengda again impeached him, requesting added exile and execution.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Censor Liang Chengda again impeached him, requesting added exile and execution.

sentences.zh: 上曰：“仲尼不為已甚。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Confucius did not go too far.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Confucius did not go too far.

sentences.zh: ”乃止。

translations.literal: " And so it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: And so it stopped.

sentences.zh: 既歸，修《讀書記》，語門人曰：“此人君為治之門，如有用我者，執此以往。

translations.literal: After returning home, he compiled Records of Reading and told his disciples: "This is the gate by which a ruler governs; if anyone uses me, take this and go forth.
translations.idiomatic: After returning home, he compiled Records of Reading and told his disciples: "This is the gate by which a ruler governs. If anyone uses me, take this and go forth.

sentences.zh: ”汀寇起，德秀薦陳韡有文武才幹，常平使者史彌忠言於朝，遂起韡討平之。

translations.literal: " Bandits rose in Ting; Dexiu recommended Chen Wei as having civil and military talent; Ever-Normal Granary Commissioner Shi Mizhong spoke to the court; Chen Wei was raised and suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Ting. Dexiu recommended Chen Wei as having civil and military talent. Ever-Normal Granary Commissioner Shi Mizhong spoke to the court, and Chen Wei was raised and suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 紹定四年，改職與祠。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shaoding, his title was changed and he received a sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Shaoding, his title was changed and he received a sinecure.

sentences.zh: 五年，進徽猷閣、知泉州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to the Hall of Splendid Plans and appointed prefect of Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was promoted to the Hall of Splendid Plans and appointed prefect of Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 迎者塞路，深村百歲老人亦扶杖而出，城中歡聲動地。

translations.literal: Those welcoming him blocked the roads; centenarians in deep villages also leaned on staves and came out; joy in the city shook the earth.
translations.idiomatic: Those welcoming him blocked the roads. Centenarians in deep villages also leaned on staves and came out, and joy in the city shook the earth.

sentences.zh: 諸邑二稅法預借至六七年，德秀入境，首禁預借。

translations.literal: In all districts the two-tax law advance borrowing had reached six or seven years; Dexiu upon entering the prefecture first prohibited advance borrowing.
translations.idiomatic: In every district, advance collection under the two-tax system had reached six or seven years ahead. When Dexiu took up his post, his first act was to forbid it.

sentences.zh: 諸邑有累月不解一錢者，郡計赤立不可為。

translations.literal: In all districts some went months without paying a single coin; the prefectural treasury stood naked and nothing could be done.
translations.idiomatic: In some districts people went months without paying a single coin. The prefectural treasury was stripped bare and the administration could scarcely function.

sentences.zh: 或咎寬恤太驟，德秀謂民困如此，寧身代其苦。

translations.literal: Some blamed him for granting relief too suddenly; Dexiu said the people were so afflicted that he would rather take their suffering upon himself.
translations.idiomatic: Some blamed him for easing burdens too abruptly. Dexiu replied that with the people so afflicted, he would rather bear their hardship himself.

sentences.zh: 決訟自卯至申未已。

translations.literal: He decided lawsuits from mao hour to shen hour without stopping.
translations.idiomatic: He heard lawsuits from dawn until late afternoon without cease.

sentences.zh: 或勸嗇養精神，德秀謂郡弊無力惠民，僅有政平、訟理事當勉。

translations.literal: Some urged him to conserve his strength; Dexiu said the prefecture was so ruined it had no power to benefit the people—only fair governance and orderly lawsuits were worth striving for.
translations.idiomatic: Some urged him to conserve his strength. Dexiu said the prefecture was so exhausted it could do little for the people; fair governance and orderly lawsuits were all he could still strive for.

sentences.zh: 建炎初置南外宗政司於泉，公族僅三百人，漕司與本州給之，而朝廷歲助度牒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jianyan era the Southern External Clan Affairs Office was established at Quan; the imperial clansmen numbered only three hundred; the transport commission and this prefecture supplied them, while the court yearly aided with ordination certificates.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Jianyan era the Southern External Clan Affairs Office was set up at Quanzhou. The imperial clansmen numbered only three hundred; the transport commission and the prefecture supported them, and the court each year supplied ordination certificates.

sentences.zh: 已而不復給，而增至二千三百餘人，郡坐是愈不可為。

translations.literal: Before long the aid ceased, yet the number rose to more than twenty-three hundred; because of this the prefecture became ever more unmanageable.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the court stopped the aid, yet the clansmen grew to more than twenty-three hundred. The prefecture, burdened thus, grew ever harder to govern.

sentences.zh: 德秀請於朝，詔給度牒百道。

translations.literal: Dexiu petitioned the court; an edict granted one hundred ordination certificates.
translations.idiomatic: Dexiu petitioned the court, and an edict granted one hundred ordination certificates.

sentences.zh: 彌遠薨，上親政，以顯謨閣待制知福州。

translations.literal: Miyuan died; the emperor personally governed; Dexiu was made Exalted Virtue Pavilion Attendant-in-Waiting and prefect of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Miyuan died and the emperor took the reins of government himself, Dexiu was appointed Exalted Virtue Pavilion Attendant-in-Waiting and prefect of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戒所部無濫刑橫斂，無徇私黷貨，罷市令司，曰：“物同則價同，寧有公私之異？

translations.literal: He admonished his jurisdiction against indiscriminate punishments and extortionate collection, against private favor and corrupt greed for goods; he abolished the market superintendent office, saying: "When goods are the same, prices should be the same—how can there be a difference between public and private?"
translations.idiomatic: He admonished his jurisdiction to forgo indiscriminate punishments and extortionate levies, and to shun private favor and corrupt gain. He abolished the market superintendent office, saying, "When goods are the same, prices should be the same. How can there be a difference between public and private?"

sentences.zh: ”閩縣裏正苦督賦，革之。

translations.literal: " In Min County village headmen suffered under forced tax collection; he abolished the office.
translations.idiomatic: In Min County village headmen had suffered under forced tax collection; he abolished the office.

sentences.zh: 屬縣苦貴糴，便宜發常平賑之。

translations.literal: Subordinate counties suffered from dear grain purchases; he expediently released Ever-Normal Granary stores to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate counties were hard pressed by dear grain purchases; he expediently released Ever-Normal Granary stores to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 海寇縱橫，次第禽殄之。

translations.literal: Sea bandits ran rampant; he one by one captured and destroyed them.
translations.idiomatic: Sea bandits ran rampant; he captured and destroyed them one after another.

sentences.zh: 未幾，聞金滅，京湖帥奉露布圖上八陵，而江、淮有進取潼關、黃河之議。

translations.literal: Before long came word that Jin had perished; the Jing-Hu commander-in-chief presented a victory dispatch and a map of the Eight Imperial Tombs, while along the Yangzi and Huai there were discussions of advancing to Tong Pass and the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Before long came word that Jin had fallen. The Jing-Hu commander-in-chief presented a victory dispatch and a map of the Eight Imperial Tombs, while along the Yangzi and Huai plans were debated for advancing upon Tong Pass and the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 德秀以為憂，上封事曰：“移江、淮甲兵以守無用之空城，運江、淮金穀以治不耕之廢壤，富庶之效未期，根本之弊立見。

translations.literal: Dexiu took this as cause for concern and submitted a sealed memorial saying: "To shift Yangzi-Huai armored troops to guard useless empty cities, and to transport Yangzi-Huai grain and gold to reclaim uncultivated wasteland—before prosperity can be hoped for, the fundamental harm will at once appear.
translations.idiomatic: Dexiu took this as cause for alarm and submitted a sealed memorial: "To shift Yangzi-Huai armored troops to guard useless empty cities, and to transport Yangzi-Huai grain and gold to reclaim uncultivated wasteland—before prosperity can be hoped for, the fundamental harm will at once appear.

sentences.zh: 惟陛下審之重之。

translations.literal: Only Your Majesty should examine and weigh this carefully.
translations.idiomatic: Only Your Majesty should examine and weigh this carefully.

sentences.zh: 召為戶部尚書，入見，上迎謂曰：“卿去國十年，每切思賢。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Minister of Revenue; entering audience, the emperor came forward and said: "You have been away from court ten years; I have constantly yearned for the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as Minister of Revenue. On entering audience the emperor came forward and said, "You have been away from court ten years. I have constantly yearned for the worthy.

sentences.zh: ”乃以《大學衍義》進，復陳祁天永命之說，謂“敬者德之聚。

translations.literal: " He then presented the Extension of the Great Learning and again set forth the doctrine of revering Heaven and securing the Mandate, saying, "Reverence is where virtue gathers.
translations.idiomatic: He then presented Extension of the Great Learning and again set forth the doctrine of revering Heaven and securing the Mandate, saying, "Reverence is where virtue gathers.

sentences.zh: 儀狄之酒，南威之色，盤遊弋射之娛，禽獸狗馬之玩，有一於茲，皆足害敬”。

translations.literal: The wine of Yi Di, the beauty of Nanwei, the diversions of wandering, hunting, and archery, the playthings of birds, beasts, dogs, and horses—if any one of these is present, all are enough to harm reverence."
translations.idiomatic: The wine of Yi Di, the beauty of Nanwei, the diversions of wandering, hunting, and archery, the playthings of birds, beasts, dogs, and horses—if any one of these is present, all are enough to harm reverence."

sentences.zh: 上欣然嘉納，改翰林學士、知制誥，時政多所論建。

translations.literal: The emperor gladly accepted this with praise; Dexiu was made Hanlin Academician and Drafting Drafter; on current affairs he offered many proposals.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor gladly accepted this with praise. Dexiu was made Hanlin Academician and Drafting Drafter, and on current affairs he offered many proposals.

sentences.zh: 逾年，知貢舉，已得疾，拜參知政事，同編修敕令、《經武要略》。

translations.literal: The next year he oversaw the examinations; already ill, he was appointed Vice Administrator; together he compiled edicts and the Essentials of Statecraft and Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he oversaw the examinations. Already ill, he was appointed Vice Administrator and helped compile edicts and the Essentials of Statecraft and Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三乞祠祿，上不得已，進資政殿學士、提舉萬壽觀兼侍讀，辭。

translations.literal: Three times he begged for a nominal temple post; the emperor with reluctance promoted him to Academician of the Hall for Supporting Governance, Director of the Longevity Abbey with concurrent Reader-in-Waiting; he declined.
translations.idiomatic: Three times he begged for a nominal temple post. The emperor, with reluctance, promoted him to Academician of the Hall for Supporting Governance and Director of the Longevity Abbey with concurrent Reader-in-Waiting. He declined.

sentences.zh: 疾亟，冠帶起坐，迄謝事，猶神爽不亂。

translations.literal: As his illness grew critical he put on cap and belt and sat up; to the end when he left office his spirit remained clear and undisturbed.
translations.idiomatic: As his illness grew critical he put on cap and belt and sat up. To the end, when he left office, his spirit remained clear and undisturbed.

sentences.zh: 遺表聞，上震悼，輟視朝，贈銀青光祿大夫。

translations.literal: When his death memorial was received the emperor was shaken with grief, suspended court audience, and posthumously granted him Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: When his death memorial was received the emperor was shaken with grief, suspended court audience, and posthumously granted him Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 德秀長身廣額，容貌如玉，望之者無不以公輔期之。

translations.literal: Dexiu was tall in stature with a broad forehead; his countenance was like jade; all who saw him expected he would reach the highest offices.
translations.idiomatic: Dexiu was tall in stature with a broad forehead; his countenance was like jade. All who saw him expected he would reach the highest offices.

sentences.zh: 立朝不滿十年，奏疏無慮數十萬言，皆切當世要務，直聲震朝廷。

translations.literal: In office at court for less than ten years, his memorials amounted to no less than several hundred thousand words; all struck at the urgent affairs of the age; his forthright voice shook the court.
translations.idiomatic: In office at court for less than ten years, his memorials amounted to no less than several hundred thousand words. All struck at the urgent affairs of the age, and his forthright voice shook the court.

sentences.zh: 四方人士誦其文，想見其風采。

translations.literal: Men throughout the realm recited his writings and longed to see his bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Men throughout the realm recited his writings and longed to see his bearing.

sentences.zh: 及宦遊所至，惠政深洽，不愧其言，由是中外交頌。

translations.literal: Wherever his official travels took him, benevolent governance deeply reached the people; he did not fall short of his words; hence within and without the court all praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever his official travels took him, benevolent governance deeply reached the people and he did not fall short of his words. Hence within and without the court all praised him.

sentences.zh: 都城人時驚傳傾洞，奔擁出關曰：“真直院至矣！

translations.literal: People in the capital at times were startled by rumor spreading like thunder; they rushed and crowded out the gate saying: "The True Straight Academician has arrived!"
translations.idiomatic: People in the capital at times were startled by rumor spreading like thunder. They rushed and crowded out the gate, crying, "The True Straight Academician has arrived!"

sentences.zh: ”果至，則又填塞聚觀不置。

translations.literal: " When he did arrive, they again packed the streets and watched without end.
translations.idiomatic: When he did arrive, they again packed the streets and watched without end.

sentences.zh: 時相益以此忌之，輒擯不用，而聲愈彰。

translations.literal: The chief ministers all the more envied him for this and repeatedly kept him out of office, yet his renown grew only brighter.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers all the more envied him for this and repeatedly kept him out of office, yet his renown grew only brighter.

sentences.zh: 及歸朝，適鄭清之挑敵，兵民死者數十萬，中外大耗，尤世道升降治亂之機，而德秀則既衰矣。

translations.literal: When he returned to court, Zheng Qingzhi had just provoked the enemy; soldiers and civilians dead numbered in the hundreds of thousands; within and without the court was greatly drained—it was especially the pivot of the world's rise and fall, order and chaos—and Dexiu by then was already in decline.
translations.idiomatic: When he returned to court, Zheng Qingzhi had just provoked the enemy. Soldiers and civilians dead numbered in the hundreds of thousands, and within and without the court was greatly drained. It was especially the pivot on which the age's rise and fall, order and chaos, turned—and Dexiu by then was already in decline.

sentences.zh: 杜範方攻清之誤國，且謂其貪黷更甚於前，而德秀乃奏言：“此皆前權臣玩悽之罪，今日措置之失，譬如和、扁繼庸醫之後，一藥之誤，代為庸醫受責。

translations.literal: Du Fan was then attacking Qingzhi for ruining the state and saying his greed and corruption exceeded what had gone before, yet Dexiu memorialized: "These are all the crimes of the former powerful minister's negligent governance and today's failures in handling affairs. It is like Yi He and Bian Que succeeding quack doctors—one mistaken dose, and the successor takes the quack's blame.
translations.idiomatic: Du Fan was then attacking Qingzhi for ruining the state and saying his greed and corruption exceeded what had gone before. Yet Dexiu memorialized, "These are all the crimes of the former powerful minister's negligent governance and today's failures in handling affairs. It is like Yi He and Bian Que succeeding quack doctors—one mistaken dose, and the successor takes the quack's blame.

sentences.zh: ”其議論與範不同如此。

translations.literal: " His opinions differed from Fan's to this extent.
translations.idiomatic: His opinions differed from Fan's to this extent.

sentences.zh: 然自侂胄立偽學之名以錮善類，凡近世大儒之書，皆顯禁以絕之。

translations.literal: Yet from the time Tuozhou established the name of False Learning to lock away men of worth, all books of the great recent Confucians were openly banned to cut them off.
translations.idiomatic: Yet from the time Tuozhou established the name of False Learning to lock away men of worth, all books of the great recent Confucians were openly banned to cut them off.

sentences.zh: 德秀晚出，獨慨然以斯文自任，講習而服行之。

translations.literal: Dexiu emerged late, alone taking up this culture with resolve, lecturing and practicing it in earnest.
translations.idiomatic: Dexiu emerged late and alone took up this culture with resolve, lecturing on it and practicing it in earnest.

sentences.zh: 黨禁既開，而正學遂明於天下後世，多其力也。

translations.literal: When the factional prohibition was lifted, correct learning was then made clear to the realm and later ages—much of this was his doing.
translations.idiomatic: When the factional prohibition was lifted, correct learning was then made clear to the realm and later ages—much of this was his doing.

sentences.zh: 所著《西山甲乙稿》、《對越甲乙集》、《經筵講義》、《端平廟議》、《翰林詞草四六》、《獻忠集》、《江東救荒錄》、《清源雜志》、《星沙集志》。

translations.literal: His works included Western Mountain Drafts A and B, Reverence toward Yue Collection A and B, Lectures for the Classics Mat, Duanping Temple Discussions, Hanlin Rhyme-prose Drafts, Offering Loyalty Collection, Jiangdong Famine Relief Record, Qingyuan Miscellany, and Xingsha Local Gazetteer.
translations.idiomatic: His works included Western Mountain Drafts A and B, Reverence toward Yue Collection A and B, Lectures for the Classics Mat, Duanping Temple Discussions, Hanlin Rhyme-prose Drafts, Offering Loyalty Collection, Jiangdong Famine Relief Record, Qingyuan Miscellany, and Xingsha Local Gazetteer.

sentences.zh: 既薨，上思之不置，諡曰文忠。

translations.literal: After he died the emperor thought of him ceaselessly and granted the posthumous title Literary Loyal.
translations.idiomatic: After he died the emperor thought of him ceaselessly and granted the posthumous title Literary Loyal.

sentences.zh: 魏了翁

translations.literal: Wei Leweng.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Leweng

sentences.zh: 魏了翁，字華父，邛州蒲江人。

translations.literal: Wei Leweng, courtesy name Huafu, was a native of Pujiang in Qiong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Leweng, whose courtesy name was Huafu, came from Pujiang in Qiong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 年數歲，從諸兄入學，儼如成人。

translations.literal: At a few years of age he followed his elder brothers to school, as solemn as an adult.
translations.idiomatic: At a few years of age he followed his elder brothers to school, as solemn as an adult.

sentences.zh: 少長，英悟絕出，日誦千餘言，過目不再覽，鄉里稱為神童。

translations.literal: As he grew, his brilliance and insight were unmatched; daily he recited more than a thousand words; what passed before his eyes he never read again; his village called him a prodigy.
translations.idiomatic: As he grew, his brilliance and insight were unmatched. Daily he recited more than a thousand words, and what he read once he never needed to read again. His village called him a prodigy.

sentences.zh: 年十五，著《韓愈論》，抑揚頓挫，有作者風。

translations.literal: At fifteen he wrote On Han Yu, with cadence and force in rise and fall; it had the air of a master writer.
translations.idiomatic: At fifteen he wrote On Han Yu, with cadence and force in rise and fall. It had the air of a master writer.

sentences.zh: 慶元五年，登進士第。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of the Qingyuan era he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Qingyuan era he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 時方諱言道學，了翁策及之。

translations.literal: At the time Dao Learning was taboo to speak of; Leweng's examination essay touched on it.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Dao Learning was taboo to speak of. Leweng's examination essay touched on it.

sentences.zh: 授僉書劍南西川節度判官廳公事，盡心職業。

translations.literal: He was appointed Registry Clerk for the Martial Affairs Section of the Sword-South West Circuit Military Commission, and devoted himself wholeheartedly to his duties.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Registry Clerk for the Martial Affairs Section of the Sword-South West Circuit Military Commission and devoted himself wholeheartedly to his duties.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰二年，召為國子正。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Jiatai era he was summoned as Instructor of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Jiatai era he was summoned as Instructor of the National University.

sentences.zh: 明年，改武學博士。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to Erudite of the Military Academy.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was transferred to Erudite of the Military Academy.

sentences.zh: 開禧元年，召試學士院。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Kaixi era he was summoned to the Hanlin Examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Kaixi era he was summoned to the Hanlin Examination.

sentences.zh: 韓侂胄用事，謀開邊以自固，遍國中憂駭而不敢言。

translations.literal: Han Tuozhou held power and plotted to open the frontier to secure himself; throughout the realm all were anxious and alarmed yet dared not speak.
translations.idiomatic: Han Tuozhou held power and plotted to open the frontier to secure himself. Throughout the realm all were anxious and alarmed yet dared not speak.

sentences.zh: 了翁乃言：“國家紀綱不立，國是不定，風俗苟偷，邊備廢弛，財用凋耗，人才衰弱，而道路籍籍，皆謂將有此北伐之舉，人情恟恟，憂疑錯出。

translations.literal: Leweng then said: "The state's institutions are not established; the national direction is unsettled; customs are careless and lax; frontier defense is neglected and slack; revenues are drained; talent is enfeebled—yet on the roads there is widespread talk that a northern expedition is about to take place; hearts are agitated; worry and doubt arise everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Leweng then said, "The state's institutions are not established. The national direction is unsettled. Customs are careless and lax, frontier defense is neglected, revenues are drained, and talent is enfeebled. Yet on the roads there is widespread talk that a northern expedition is about to take place. Hearts are agitated; worry and doubt arise everywhere.

sentences.zh: 金地廣勢強，未可卒圖，求其在我，未見可以勝人之實。

translations.literal: Jin's territory is broad and its power strong; it cannot be quickly taken. Seeking what lies within ourselves, I see no substance by which we can overcome others.
translations.idiomatic: Jin's territory is broad and its power strong; it cannot be quickly taken. Seeking what lies within ourselves, I see no substance by which we can overcome others.

sentences.zh: 盍亦急於內修，姑逭外攘。

translations.literal: Why not urgently attend to internal cultivation and for now defer external conflict?
translations.idiomatic: Why not urgently attend to internal cultivation and for now defer external conflict?

sentences.zh: 不然，舉天下而試於一擲，宗社存亡係焉，不可忽也。

translations.literal: Otherwise, to stake the whole realm on one throw—on this the altars of state and ancestral temple rise or fall; it cannot be lightly treated.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, to stake the whole realm on one throw—on this the altars of state and ancestral temple rise or fall. It cannot be lightly treated.

sentences.zh: ”策出，眾大驚。

translations.literal: " When the examination essay was released, all were greatly startled.
translations.idiomatic: When the examination essay was released, all were greatly startled.

sentences.zh: 改秘書省正字。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Corrector of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Corrector of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 御史徐柟即劾了翁對策狂妄，獨侂胄持不可而止。

translations.literal: Censor Xu Shan immediately impeached Leweng for reckless answers in the examination; only Tuozhou held it could not be done and stopped the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Xu Shan immediately impeached Leweng for reckless answers in the examination. Only Tuozhou held that it could not be done and stopped the matter.

sentences.zh: 明年，遷校書郎，以親老乞補外，乃知嘉定府。

translations.literal: The next year he was promoted to Collator; as his parents were aged he begged an outer post and was made prefect of Jiading Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was promoted to Collator. As his parents were aged he begged an outer post and was made prefect of Jiading Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 行次江陵，蜀大將吳曦以四川叛，了翁策其必敗。

translations.literal: En route he stopped at Jiangling; the great Shu general Wu Xi rebelled with Sichuan; Leweng reckoned he would surely fail.
translations.idiomatic: En route he stopped at Jiangling. The great Shu general Wu Xi rebelled with Sichuan. Leweng reckoned he would surely fail.

sentences.zh: 又明年，曦誅，蜀平，了翁奉親還裏。

translations.literal: The year after, Xi was executed, Shu was pacified, and Leweng escorted his parents home.
translations.idiomatic: The year after, Xi was executed, Shu was pacified, and Leweng escorted his parents home.

sentences.zh: 侂胄亦以誤國誅。

translations.literal: Tuozhou was also executed for ruining the state.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou was also executed for ruining the state.

sentences.zh: 朝廷收召諸賢，了翁預焉。

translations.literal: The court recalled the worthies; Leweng was among them.
translations.idiomatic: The court recalled the worthies, and Leweng was among them.

sentences.zh: 會史彌遠入相專國事，了翁察其所為，力辭召命。

translations.literal: When Shi Miyuan entered as chief minister and monopolized state affairs, Leweng scrutinized his conduct and forcefully declined the summons.
translations.idiomatic: When Shi Miyuan entered as chief minister and monopolized state affairs, Leweng scrutinized his conduct and forcefully declined the summons.

sentences.zh: 丁生父憂，解官心喪，築室白鶴山下，以所聞於輔廣、李燔者開門授徒，士爭負笈從之。

translations.literal: On the death of his birth father he left office in heart-mourning, built a house beneath White Crane Mountain, and with what he had learned from Fu Guang and Li Fan opened his doors to teach; scholars vied to carry books and follow him.
translations.idiomatic: On the death of his birth father he left office in heart-mourning, built a house beneath White Crane Mountain, and with what he had learned from Fu Guang and Li Fan opened his doors to teach. Scholars vied to carry books and follow him.

sentences.zh: 由是蜀人盡知義理之學。

translations.literal: From this the people of Shu came fully to know the learning of principle and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: From this the people of Shu came fully to know the learning of principle and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 差知漢州。

translations.literal: He was appointed prefect of Han Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed prefect of Han Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 漢號為繁劇，了翁以化善俗為治。

translations.literal: Han was known as busy and complex; Leweng took transforming customs toward goodness as his method of rule.
translations.idiomatic: Han was known as busy and complex. Leweng took transforming customs toward goodness as his method of rule.

sentences.zh: 首蠲積逋二十餘萬，除科抑賣酒之弊，嚴戶婚交訐之禁，復為文諭以厚倫止訟，其民敬奉條教不敢犯。

translations.literal: First he remitted accumulated arrears of more than two hundred thousand; he removed the abuse of forced wine monopolies under tax levies; he strictly forbade household and marriage denunciations; again he issued written admonitions to strengthen human relations and halt lawsuits—the people reverently obeyed his regulations and did not dare violate them.
translations.idiomatic: First he remitted accumulated arrears of more than two hundred thousand. He removed the abuse of forced wine monopolies under tax levies and strictly forbade household and marriage denunciations. Again he issued written admonitions to strengthen human relations and halt lawsuits. The people reverently obeyed his regulations and did not dare violate them.

sentences.zh: 會境內橋壞，民有壓死者，部使者以聞，詔降官一秩、主管建寧府武夷山衝佑觀。

translations.literal: When a bridge within the jurisdiction collapsed and people were crushed to death, the circuit commissioner reported it; an edict demoted him one rank and made him Director of the Chongyou Abbey on Mount Wuyi in Jianning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When a bridge within the jurisdiction collapsed and people were crushed to death, the circuit commissioner reported it. An edict demoted him one rank and made him Director of the Chongyou Abbey on Mount Wuyi in Jianning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 未數月，復元官、知眉州。

translations.literal: Within a few months his original rank was restored and he was made prefect of Mei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few months his original rank was restored and he was made prefect of Mei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 眉雖為文物之邦，然其俗習法令，持吏短長，故號難治。

translations.literal: Mei, though a land of culture and refinement, had a custom of studying laws and regulations and finding fault with officials—hence it was called hard to govern.
translations.idiomatic: Mei, though a land of culture and refinement, had a custom of studying laws and regulations and finding fault with officials. Hence it was called hard to govern.

sentences.zh: 聞了翁至，爭試以事。

translations.literal: When they heard Leweng had arrived, they vied to test him with incidents.
translations.idiomatic: When they heard Leweng had arrived, they vied to test him with incidents.

sentences.zh: 乃尊禮耆耇，簡拔俊秀，朔望詣學宮，親為講說，誘掖指授，行鄉飲酒禮以示教化，增貢士員以振文風。

translations.literal: He then honored the aged, selected and promoted talented youths, on the first and fifteenth of each month went to the school and personally lectured, guiding and instructing; he performed the village drinking ceremony to show moral transformation; he increased quota for tribute students to revive literary culture.
translations.idiomatic: He then honored the aged and selected and promoted talented youths. On the first and fifteenth of each month he went to the school and personally lectured, guiding and instructing. He performed the village drinking ceremony to show moral transformation and increased the quota for tribute students to revive literary culture.

sentences.zh: 復蟆頤堰，築江鄉館，利民之事，知無不為。

translations.literal: He restored the Mafu weir, built the Riverside Lodge, and for anything benefiting the people, if he knew of it he did not fail to act.
translations.idiomatic: He restored the Mafu weir and built the Riverside Lodge. For anything benefiting the people, if he knew of it he did not fail to act.

sentences.zh: 士論大服，俗為之變，治行彰聞。

translations.literal: Public opinion among scholars was greatly won over; customs changed accordingly; his record of governance was widely heard.
translations.idiomatic: Public opinion among scholars was greatly won over. Customs changed accordingly, and his record of governance was widely heard.

sentences.zh: 嘉定四年，擢潼川路提點刑獄公事。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of the Jiading era he was promoted to Judicial Intendant of the Tongchuan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Jiading era he was promoted to Judicial Intendant of the Tongchuan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 八年，兼提舉常平等事，遷轉運判官。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he concurrently held charge of Ever-Normal and related affairs and was transferred to Transport Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he concurrently held charge of Ever-Normal and related affairs and was transferred to Transport Vice Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戢吏奸，詢民瘼，舉刺不避權右，風采肅然。

translations.literal: He curbed official corruption, inquired into the people's distress, reported and censured without avoiding the powerful and noble; his authority was austere and commanding.
translations.idiomatic: He curbed official corruption and inquired into the people's distress. He reported and censured without avoiding the powerful and noble, and his authority was austere and commanding.

sentences.zh: 上疏乞與周惇頤、張載、程顥、程頤錫爵定諡，示學者趣向，朝論韙之，如其請。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial begging that Zhou Dunyi, Zhang Zai, Cheng Hao, and Cheng Yi be granted noble ranks and fixed posthumous titles to show scholars where to turn; court opinion approved, and his request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial begging that Zhou Dunyi, Zhang Zai, Cheng Hao, and Cheng Yi be granted noble ranks and fixed posthumous titles to show scholars where to turn. Court opinion approved, and his request was granted.

sentences.zh: 遂寧闕守，了翁行郡事。

translations.literal: Suining lacked a prefect; Leweng administered the prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Suining lacked a prefect, and Leweng administered the prefectural affairs.

sentences.zh: 即具奏乞修城郭備不虞，廷議靳其費，了翁增埤浚隍，如待敵至者。

translations.literal: He immediately submitted a full memorial begging to repair walls and guard against the unexpected; court deliberation was stingy with the expense, yet Leweng added ramparts and dredged moats as if awaiting the enemy's arrival.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately submitted a full memorial begging to repair walls and guard against the unexpected. Court deliberation was stingy with the expense, yet Leweng added ramparts and dredged moats as if awaiting the enemy's arrival.

sentences.zh: 後一年，潰卒攻掠郡縣，知其有備不敢逞，人始服豫防之意。

translations.literal: A year later mutinous soldiers attacked and plundered prefectures and counties; knowing he was prepared they did not dare act rashly; people then came to approve his intention of advance precaution.
translations.idiomatic: A year later mutinous soldiers attacked and plundered prefectures and counties. Knowing he was prepared they did not dare act rashly, and people then came to approve his intention of advance precaution.

sentences.zh: 十年，遷直秘閣、知瀘州、主管潼川路安撫司公事。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to Direct Associate of the Secretariat Archive, prefect of Luzhou, and Supervisor of the Tongchuan Circuit Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was transferred to Direct Associate of the Secretariat Archive, prefect of Luzhou, and Supervisor of the Tongchuan Circuit Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，免喪，差知潼川府。

translations.literal: On his mother's death he mourned; when mourning ended he was appointed prefect of Tongchuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On his mother's death he mourned. When mourning ended he was appointed prefect of Tongchuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 約己裕民，厥績大著。

translations.literal: He restrained himself and enriched the people; his achievements were greatly conspicuous.
translations.idiomatic: He restrained himself and enriched the people. His achievements were greatly conspicuous.

sentences.zh: 若遊似、吳泳、牟子才，皆蜀名士，造門受業。

translations.literal: Men such as You Si, Wu Yong, and Mou Zicai—all noted Shu scholars—came to his gate to receive instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Men such as You Si, Wu Yong, and Mou Zicai—all noted Shu scholars—came to his gate to receive instruction.

sentences.zh: 十五年，被召入對，疏二千餘言。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was summoned for audience and submitted a memorial of more than two thousand words.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was summoned for audience and submitted a memorial of more than two thousand words.

sentences.zh: 首論人與天地一本，必與天地相似而後可以無曠天位，並及人才、風俗五事，明白切暢。

translations.literal: First he argued that man and Heaven and Earth share one root; only by being similar to Heaven and Earth can one not neglect Heaven's position; together with five matters of talent and custom, his meaning was clear, incisive, and fluent.
translations.idiomatic: First he argued that man and Heaven and Earth share one root, and that only by being similar to Heaven and Earth can one not neglect Heaven's position. Together with five matters of talent and custom, his meaning was clear, incisive, and fluent.

sentences.zh: 又論郡邑強幹弱枝之弊，所宜變通。

translations.literal: He again discussed the harm of strong branches and weak trunks in prefectures and counties, which ought to be changed.
translations.idiomatic: He again discussed the harm of strong branches and weak trunks in prefectures and counties, which ought to be changed.

sentences.zh: 蓋自了翁去國十有七年矣，至是上迎勞優渥，嘉納其言。

translations.literal: For Leweng had been away from court seventeen years; when he arrived the emperor welcomed and treated him with exceptional favor and praised and accepted his words.
translations.idiomatic: Leweng had been away from court seventeen years. When he arrived the emperor welcomed and treated him with exceptional favor and praised and accepted his words.

sentences.zh: 進兵部郎中，俄改司封郎中兼國史院編修官。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Ministry of War; soon transferred to Vice Director of the Department of Feudatory Affairs with concurrent Compiler of the National History Institute.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Ministry of War and soon transferred to Vice Director of the Department of Feudatory Affairs with concurrent Compiler of the National History Institute.

sentences.zh: 轉對，論江、淮、襄、蜀當分為四重鎮，擇人以任，虛心以聽，假以事權，資以才用，為聯絡守禦之計。

translations.literal: In rotation audience he argued that the Yangzi, Huai, Xiang, and Shu regions should be divided into four key garrisons; choose men to appoint them; listen with open mind; lend them authority over affairs; supply them with talent and use—forming a plan of linked defense.
translations.idiomatic: In rotation audience he argued that the Yangzi, Huai, Xiang, and Shu regions should be divided into four key garrisons. Choose men to appoint them, listen with an open mind, lend them authority over affairs, and supply them with talent and use—forming a plan of linked defense.

sentences.zh: 次論蜀邊墾田及實錄闕文等事，皆下其章中書。

translations.literal: Next he discussed Shu frontier reclamation and lacunae in the Veritable Records, and the like; all his memorials were sent down to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Next he discussed Shu frontier reclamation and lacunae in the Veritable Records, and the like. All his memorials were sent down to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十六年，為省試參詳官，遷太常少卿兼侍立修注官。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he served as Evaluation Officer for the provincial examination and was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices with concurrent Attendant Recorder and Annotator.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he served as Evaluation Officer for the provincial examination and was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices with concurrent Attendant Recorder and Annotator.

sentences.zh: 十七年，遷秘書監，尋以起居舍人再辭而後就列。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to Director of the Secretariat; soon as Recorder of the Emperor's Words he declined twice before finally taking his post.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to Director of the Secretariat. Soon, as Recorder of the Emperor's Words, he declined twice before finally taking his post.

sentences.zh: 入奏，極言事變倚伏、人心向背、疆埸安危、鄰寇動靜，其幾有五，謂：“宜察時幾而共天命，尊道揆而嚴法守，集思廣益，汲汲圖之，不猶愈於坐觀事會，而聽其勢之所趨乎？

translations.literal: Entering to memorialize, he spoke at length on the ebb and flow of affairs, the turn of hearts toward or away, the safety or peril of the borders, and the movements of neighboring enemies—of these there are five critical points; he said: "One should discern the times and share Heaven's Mandate, honor the Way and measure affairs and strictly uphold the law, gather thoughts and broaden benefit, and urgently plan for them—is this not better than sitting and watching events unfold while letting the tide of power run its course?"
translations.idiomatic: Entering to memorialize, he spoke at length on the ebb and flow of affairs, the turn of hearts toward or away, the safety or peril of the borders, and the movements of neighboring enemies—of these there are five critical points. He said, "One should discern the times and share Heaven's Mandate, honor the Way and measure affairs and strictly uphold the law, gather thoughts and broaden benefit, and urgently plan for them. Is this not better than sitting and watching events unfold while letting the tide of power run its course?"

sentences.zh: ”又論士大夫風俗之弊，謂：“君臣上下同心一德，而後平居有所補益，緩急有所倚仗。

translations.literal: " He again discussed the corruption of scholar-official custom, saying: "Only when ruler and ministers above and below share one heart and one virtue can they in ordinary times give mutual benefit and in urgent crisis have one another to rely on.
translations.idiomatic: He again discussed the corruption of scholar-official custom, saying, "Only when ruler and ministers above and below share one heart and one virtue can they in ordinary times give mutual benefit and in urgent crisis have one another to rely on.

sentences.zh: 如人自為謀，則天下之患有不可終窮者。

translations.literal: If each man schemes for himself, then the realm's troubles will have no end that can ever be exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: If each man schemes for himself, then the realm's troubles will have no end that can ever be exhausted.

sentences.zh: 今則麵從而腹誹，習諛而踵陋，臣實懼焉。

translations.literal: Now they comply in face yet slander in belly, practice flattery and follow vulgarity in succession—I, your subject, truly fear this.
translations.idiomatic: Now men comply to one's face yet slander in their hearts, habitually flatter and perpetuate vulgarity. I truly fear this.

sentences.zh: 盍亦察人心之邪正，推世變之倚伏，開拓規模，收拾人物，庶幾臨事無乏人之歎。

translations.literal: Why not also examine the crooked and upright in men's hearts, trace the rise and fall of worldly change, expand the scope of policy, gather men of talent—so that when affairs arise there will be no sighing over lack of capable men?
translations.idiomatic: Why not examine whether hearts are upright or crooked, trace the ebb and flow of change in the world, broaden the scope of governance, and gather capable men—so that when crisis comes there will be no lament over a shortage of talent?

sentences.zh: ”其言剴切，無所忌避，而時相始不樂矣。

translations.literal: " His words were incisive, without any fear or evasion, and the chief minister at last became displeased.
translations.idiomatic: His words were incisive and without fear or evasion, and the chief minister at last became displeased.

sentences.zh: 寧宗崩，理宗自宗室入即位，時事忽異，了翁積憂成疾，三疏求閑不得請，遷起居郎。

translations.literal: When Ningzong died, Lizong entered from the imperial clan to ascend the throne; affairs suddenly changed; Leweng's accumulated worries turned to illness; thrice he memorialized to request retirement but was not granted it; he was transferred to Attendant of the Emperor's Words.
translations.idiomatic: When Ningzong died and Lizong ascended the throne from among the imperial clan, affairs suddenly changed. Leweng's accumulated worries turned to illness. Thrice he memorialized to request retirement but was not granted it, and he was transferred to Attendant of the Emperor's Words.

sentences.zh: 明年，改元寶慶，雷發非時，上有“朕心終夕不安”之語，了翁入對，即論：“人主之心，義理所安，是之謂天，非此心之外，別有所謂天地神明也。

translations.literal: The next year the era name was changed to Baoqing; thunder struck out of season; the emperor had the words "my heart is uneasy all night long"; Leweng entered audience and at once argued: "The ruler's heart—what righteousness and principle can settle is what is called Heaven; beyond this heart there is no separate so-called Heaven, Earth, and spirits."
translations.idiomatic: The next year the era name was changed to Baoqing. Thunder struck out of season, and the emperor said, “My heart is uneasy all night long.” Leweng entered audience and at once argued, “The ruler’s heart—what righteousness and principle can settle is what is called Heaven. Beyond this heart there is no separate Heaven, Earth, and spirits.”

sentences.zh: 陛下盍即不安而求之，對天地，事太母，見群臣，親講讀，皆隨事反求，則大本立而無事不可為矣。

translations.literal: Your Majesty, why not take your unease and seek into it—toward Heaven and Earth, in serving the Grand Empress Dowager, in receiving ministers, in personally attending lectures—seeking reflectively in each matter? Then the great foundation is established and nothing cannot be done.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty, why not take your unease and seek into it—before Heaven and Earth, in serving the Grand Empress Dowager, in receiving your ministers, in personally attending the lectures—reflecting back upon each matter as it arises? Then the great foundation will be established and nothing will be impossible.

sentences.zh: ”又論：“講學不明，風俗浮淺，立朝無犯顏敢諫之忠，臨難無仗節死義之勇。

translations.literal: " He again argued: "Study of the Way is unclear; custom is shallow and frivolous; in court there is no loyalty of those who risk the ruler's countenance to remonstrate; facing crisis there is no courage of those who uphold integrity and die for righteousness."
translations.idiomatic: He again argued, “The pursuit of learning is unclear and customs are shallow. In court there is no loyalty of those who risk the ruler’s displeasure to remonstrate; facing crisis there is no courage of those who uphold integrity and die for righteousness.”

sentences.zh: 願敷求碩儒，丕闡正學，圖為久安長治之計。

translations.literal: I wish that eminent scholars be widely sought, orthodox learning greatly expounded, and the plan plotted for lasting peace and long governance.
translations.idiomatic: I wish that eminent scholars be widely sought and orthodox learning greatly expounded, plotting the plan for lasting peace and long-term governance.

sentences.zh: ”又請申命大臣，於除授之際，公聽並觀，然後實意所孚，善類皆出矣。

translations.literal: " He again requested that clear orders be issued to grand ministers: at the time of appointments and dismissals, listen publicly and observe together—then only when sincerity is trusted will the good sort all emerge.
translations.idiomatic: He again requested that clear orders be issued to grand ministers: at the time of appointments and dismissals, listen openly and observe together—then when sincerity is trusted, the good will all emerge.

sentences.zh: 屬濟王黜削以死，有司顧望，治葬弗虔。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Ji was demoted and stripped until he died, the responsible officials hesitated and looked about; his burial was not handled with due reverence.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Ji was demoted and stripped of rank until he died, the responsible officials hesitated, and his burial was not handled with due reverence.

sentences.zh: 了翁每見上，請厚倫紀，以弭人言。

translations.literal: Each time Leweng saw the emperor he requested that moral relations be strengthened to quell public talk.
translations.idiomatic: Each time Leweng saw the emperor he urged strengthening moral obligations to quiet public talk.

sentences.zh: 應詔言事者十餘人，朝士惟了翁與洪谘夔、胡夢昱、張忠恕所言能引義劘上，最為切至，而了翁亦以疾求去。

translations.literal: More than ten responded to the imperial decree to speak on affairs; among court officials only Leweng, Hong Zikui, Hu Mengyu, and Zhang Zhongshu could draw on principle to admonish the emperor—their words were most incisive—and Leweng also requested leave on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten men responded to the imperial decree to speak on affairs. Among court officials only Leweng, Hong Zikui, Hu Mengyu, and Zhang Zhongshu could draw on principle to admonish the emperor—their words were the most incisive—and Leweng also requested leave on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 右正言李知孝劾夢昱竄嶺南，了翁出關餞別，遂指了翁首倡異論，將擊之，彌遠猶外示優容。

translations.literal: Right Remonstrator Li Zhixiao impeached Mengyu and banished him south of the Ling; Leweng went out of the pass to see him off with a farewell feast; Li then pointed to Leweng as the first to raise heterodox views and was about to attack him; Miyuan still outwardly showed forbearance.
translations.idiomatic: Right Remonstrator Li Zhixiao impeached Mengyu and banished him south of the Ling. Leweng went out of the pass to see him off with a farewell feast. Li then pointed to Leweng as the first to raise heterodox views and was about to attack him, but Miyuan still outwardly showed forbearance.

sentences.zh: 俄權尚書工部侍郎，了翁力以疾辭，乃以集英殿修撰知常德府。
