translations.literal: Soon he was acting Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works; Leweng forcefully declined on grounds of illness; he was then made Compiler at the Hall for Cultivating Talent and prefect of Changde.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made acting Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works. Leweng forcefully declined on grounds of illness and was instead appointed Compiler at the Hall for Cultivating Talent and prefect of Changde.

sentences.zh: 越二日，諫議大夫朱端常遂劾了翁欺世盜名，朋邪謗國，詔降三官、靖州居住。

translations.literal: Two days later Remonstrance and Discussion Grandee Zhu Duanchang impeached Leweng for deceiving the world and stealing a name, befriending the wicked and slandering the state; an edict demoted him three ranks and ordered residence at Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later Remonstrance and Discussion Grandee Zhu Duanchang impeached Leweng for deceiving the world and stealing renown, befriending the wicked and slandering the state. An edict demoted him three ranks and ordered him to reside at Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 初，了翁再入朝，彌遠欲引以自助，了翁正色不撓，未嚐私謁。

translations.literal: At first, when Leweng reentered court, Miyuan wished to draw him in to assist himself; Leweng with stern countenance would not bend and never once paid a private visit.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Leweng reentered court, Miyuan wished to draw him in as an ally. Leweng remained stern and unyielding and never once paid a private visit.

sentences.zh: 故三年之間，循格序遷，未嚐處以要地。

translations.literal: Thus within three years he was transferred in order according to the ranks and never once placed in an important post.
translations.idiomatic: Thus for three years he was transferred in rank order and was never placed in an important post.

sentences.zh: 了翁至靖，湖、湘、江、浙之士，不遠千里負書從學。

translations.literal: When Leweng reached Jing, scholars of Hunan, Xiang, Jiang, and Zhe came from a thousand li bearing books to study under him.
translations.idiomatic: When Leweng reached Jing, scholars from Hunan, the Xiang region, Jiang, and Zhe traveled from afar bearing books to study under him.

sentences.zh: 乃著《九經要義》百卷，訂定精密，先儒所未有。

translations.literal: He then authored one hundred fascicles of Essentials of the Nine Classics, exquisitely refined in collation—what earlier Confucians had never had.
translations.idiomatic: He then authored one hundred fascicles of Essentials of the Nine Classics, exquisitely refined in collation—something earlier Confucians had never produced.

sentences.zh: 紹定四年復職，主管建寧府武夷山衝佑觀。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shaoding he was restored to office, in charge of the Chongyou Abbey on Mount Wuyi in Jianning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Shaoding he was restored to office and put in charge of the Chongyou Abbey on Mount Wuyi in Jianning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五年，改差提舉江州太平興國宮，尋知遂寧府，辭不拜。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was reassigned to oversee the Taiping Xingguo Palace in Jiang Prefecture; soon made prefect of Suining Prefecture; he declined and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was reassigned to oversee the Taiping Xingguo Palace in Jiang Prefecture. Soon he was made prefect of Suining Prefecture but declined and did not accept.

sentences.zh: 進寶章閣待制、潼川路安撫使、知瀘州。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Baochan Pavilion Attendant-in-Waiting, Sichuan Pacification Commissioner of Tongchuan Circuit, and prefect of Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Baochan Pavilion Attendant-in-Waiting, made Sichuan Pacification Commissioner of Tongchuan Circuit, and appointed prefect of Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 瀘大藩，控製邊麵二千里，而武備不修，城郭不治。

translations.literal: Lu was a great fu; controlling the frontier face for two thousand li, yet military preparedness was not maintained and walls and moats were not repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Lu was a major commandery controlling two thousand li of frontier, yet military preparedness was neglected and the walls and moats were unrepaired.

sentences.zh: 了翁乃奏葺其城樓櫓雉堞，增置器械，教習牌手，申嚴軍律，興學校，蠲宿負，復社倉，創義塚，建養濟院。

translations.literal: Leweng then memorialized to repair its towers, ramparts, and battlements; add weapons and equipment; drill shield-bearers; strictly enforce military discipline; establish schools; remit longstanding debts; restore community granaries; create burial grounds for the destitute; and build homes for the relief of the needy.
translations.idiomatic: Leweng then memorialized to repair the towers, ramparts, and battlements; add weapons and equipment; drill shield-bearers; strictly enforce military discipline; establish schools; remit long-standing debts; restore community granaries; create burial grounds for the destitute; and build homes for the relief of the needy.

sentences.zh: 居數月，百廢具舉。

translations.literal: Within several months a hundred neglected matters were all undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: Within several months a hundred neglected affairs were all set right.

sentences.zh: 彌遠薨，上親庶政，進華文閣待制，賜金帶，因其任。

translations.literal: When Miyuan died the emperor personally handled ordinary governance; Leweng was promoted to Huawen Pavilion Attendant-in-Waiting and granted a gold belt, retaining his existing duties.
translations.idiomatic: When Miyuan died and the emperor personally handled governance, Leweng was promoted to Huawen Pavilion Attendant-in-Waiting and granted a gold belt, retaining his existing duties.

sentences.zh: 了翁念國家權臣相繼，內擅國柄，外變風俗，綱常淪斁，法度墮弛，貪濁在位，舉事弊蠹，不可滌濯。

translations.literal: Leweng reflected that successive powerful ministers had monopolized the state's handle within and transformed custom without; moral bonds had fallen to ruin, law and measure had collapsed and slackened; the greedy and corrupt held office; every undertaking was riddled with parasites—beyond washing clean.
translations.idiomatic: Leweng reflected that successive powerful ministers had monopolized state power within and corrupted custom without. Moral bonds had collapsed, laws and institutions had fallen into disrepair, the greedy and corrupt held office, and every undertaking was riddled with corruption beyond cleansing.

sentences.zh: 遂應詔上章論十弊，乞復舊典以彰新化：“一曰復三省之典以重六卿，二曰復二府之典以集眾議，三曰復都堂之典以重省府，四曰復侍從之典以來忠告，五曰復經筵之典以熙聖學，六曰復台諫之典以公黜陟，七曰復製誥之典以謹命令，八曰復聽言之典以通下情，九曰復三衙之典以強主威，十曰復製閫之典以黜私意。

translations.literal: He then responded to an imperial decree with a memorial discussing ten abuses, requesting restoration of old institutions to manifest new transformation: "First, restore the institution of the Three Departments to give weight to the Six Ministers; second, restore the institution of the Two Councils to gather collective deliberation; third, restore the institution of the Chief Council Hall to give weight to the secretariat and prefectures; fourth, restore the institution of attendant officials to draw forth loyal counsel; fifth, restore the institution of the Classics Colloquium to illumine sage learning; sixth, restore the institution of the Censorate and Remonstrance Bureau to make promotions and demotions public; seventh, restore the institution of drafting edicts to keep commands strict; eighth, restore the institution of receiving speech to communicate conditions below; ninth, restore the institution of the Three Commands to strengthen the ruler's authority; tenth, restore the institution of appointing commanders to dismiss private intent."
translations.idiomatic: He then responded to an imperial decree with a memorial discussing ten abuses, requesting restoration of old institutions to manifest new transformation: “First, restore the institution of the Three Departments to give weight to the Six Ministers; second, restore the institution of the Two Councils to gather collective deliberation; third, restore the institution of the Chief Council Hall to give weight to the secretariat and prefectures; fourth, restore the institution of attendant officials to draw forth loyal counsel; fifth, restore the institution of the Classics Colloquium to illumine sage learning; sixth, restore the institution of the Censorate and Remonstrance Bureau to make promotions and demotions public; seventh, restore the institution of drafting edicts to keep commands strict; eighth, restore the institution of receiving speech to communicate conditions below; ninth, restore the institution of the Three Commands to strengthen the ruler’s authority; tenth, restore the institution of appointing commanders to dismiss private intent.”

sentences.zh: 疏列萬言，先引故實，次陳時弊，分別利害，粲若白黑。

translations.literal: The memorial ran to ten thousand words; first citing ancient precedents, next stating present abuses, distinguishing benefit and harm—clear as black and white.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial ran to ten thousand words. First it cited ancient precedents, then stated present abuses, distinguishing benefit and harm as clearly as black and white.

sentences.zh: 上讀之感動，即於經筵舉之成誦。

translations.literal: The emperor read it and was moved; he immediately recited it from memory at the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor read it and was moved. He immediately recited it from memory at the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 其後，舊典皆復其初。

translations.literal: Thereafter the old institutions were all restored to their original form.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the old institutions were all restored to their original form.

sentences.zh: 臣庶封章多乞召還了翁及真德秀，上因民望而並招之，用了翁權禮部尚書兼直學士院。

translations.literal: Officials and commoners in sealed memorials largely begged to recall Leweng and Zhen Dexiu; the emperor, following public regard, summoned both; Leweng was made acting Minister of Rites with concurrent duty in the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and commoners in sealed memorials largely begged to recall Leweng and Zhen Dexiu. Following public regard, the emperor summoned both. Leweng was made acting Minister of Rites with concurrent duty in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 入對，首乞明君子小人之辨，以為進退人物之本，以杜奸邪窺伺之端。

translations.literal: Entering audience, he first requested clarifying the distinction between gentleman and petty man, taking this as the foundation for advancing and dismissing men, to block the opening by which wicked men peep and watch.
translations.idiomatic: Entering audience, he first urged clarifying the distinction between gentlemen and petty men, taking this as the foundation for advancing and dismissing men and blocking the openings by which wicked men watch for advantage.

sentences.zh: 次論故相十失猶存，又及修身、齊家、選宗賢、建內小學等，皆切於上躬者。

translations.literal: Next he discussed the ten faults of the former chief minister still remaining; he also touched on self-cultivation, ordering the family, selecting worthy members of the imperial clan, establishing an inner school, and the like—all cutting close to the emperor's own person.
translations.idiomatic: Next he discussed the ten faults of the former chief minister that still remained, and also touched on self-cultivation, ordering the family, selecting worthy members of the imperial clan, and establishing an inner school—all matters cutting close to the emperor’s own person.

sentences.zh: 他如和議不可信，北軍不可保，軍實財用不可恃，凡十餘端。

translations.literal: Other matters such as: the peace agreement cannot be trusted; northern armies cannot be relied upon; military stores and revenues cannot be depended on—in all more than ten points.
translations.idiomatic: He also addressed more than ten other points: the peace agreement could not be trusted, northern armies could not be relied upon, and military stores and revenues could not be depended on.

sentences.zh: 復口奏利害，晝漏下四十刻而退。

translations.literal: He again orally memorialized on benefit and harm, and withdrew when the day clepsydra had passed forty markings.
translations.idiomatic: He again orally memorialized on benefit and harm and withdrew when the day clepsydra had passed forty markings.

sentences.zh: 兼同修國史兼侍讀，俄兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Concurrently he was Associate Compiler of the National History and Reader; soon concurrently Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was concurrently Associate Compiler of the National History and Reader, and soon concurrently Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 經幃進讀，上必改容以聽，詢察政事，訪問人才。

translations.literal: Advancing to read in the Classics Curtain, the emperor always changed expression to listen, inquiring into government affairs and asking about men of talent.
translations.idiomatic: When he advanced to read in the Classics Curtain, the emperor always composed his expression to listen, inquiring into government affairs and asking about men of talent.

sentences.zh: 復條十事以獻，皆苦心空臆，直述事情，言人所難。

translations.literal: He again listed ten matters to present; all were born of bitter heart and empty belly—directly stating affairs, speaking what others found difficult.
translations.idiomatic: He again listed ten matters to present. All were born of bitter earnestness, directly stating affairs and speaking what others found difficult.

sentences.zh: 上悉嘉納，且手詔獎諭。

translations.literal: The emperor fully praised and accepted them, and moreover issued a personal edict of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor fully praised and accepted them and issued a personal edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 又奏乞收還保全彌遠家御筆，乞定趙汝愚配享寧廟，乞趣崔與之參預政事，乞定履畝之令以寬民力，乞詔從臣集議以救楮弊，乞儲閫才以備緩急。

translations.literal: He again memorialized requesting recovery of the imperial brush writings preserved in Shi Miyuan's household; requesting fixing Zhao Ruyu's enshrinement in Ningzong's temple; requesting urging Cui Yu'zhi to participate in governance; requesting fixing the land-measurement order to ease the people's burden; requesting an edict for attendant ministers to gather and deliberate to rescue paper currency; requesting storing commandery talent against urgent need.
translations.idiomatic: He again memorialized requesting recovery of the imperial brush writings preserved in Shi Miyuan's household; fixing Zhao Ruyu's enshrinement in Ningzong's temple; urging Cui Yu'zhi to participate in governance; fixing the land-measurement order to ease the people's burden; an edict for attendant ministers to gather and deliberate to rescue paper currency; and storing commandery talent against urgent need.

sentences.zh: 又因進故事：如儲人才、凝國論，如力圖自治之策，如下罪己之詔，如分別襄、黃二帥是非，如究見黃陂叛卒利害，如分任諸帥區處降附。

translations.literal: He also drew on advancing historical examples: such as storing talent and consolidating national debate; such as vigorously plotting policies of self-governance; such as issuing an edict of self-reproach; such as distinguishing right and wrong between the two commanders of Xiang and Huang; such as thoroughly seeing the benefit and harm of the mutinous soldiers at Huangpi; such as dividing responsibility among commanders to settle surrendered adherents.
translations.idiomatic: He also drew on historical examples in advancing his views: storing talent and consolidating national debate; vigorously plotting policies of self-governance; issuing an edict of self-reproach; distinguishing right and wrong between the two commanders of Xiang and Huang; thoroughly assessing the benefit and harm of the mutinous soldiers at Huangpi; and dividing responsibility among commanders to settle surrendered adherents.

sentences.zh: 還朝六閱月，前後二十餘奏，皆當時急務。

translations.literal: Six months after returning to court, more than twenty memorials before and after—all pressing affairs of the time.
translations.idiomatic: Six months after returning to court he submitted more than twenty memorials in all, each addressing pressing affairs of the time.

sentences.zh: 上將引以共政，而忌者相與合謀排擯，而不能安於朝矣。

translations.literal: The emperor was about to draw him in to share governance, but jealous men together conspired to exclude and repel him, and he could no longer be at ease at court.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was about to draw him in to share governance, but jealous men conspired together to exclude him, and he could no longer be at ease at court.

sentences.zh: 執政遂謂近臣惟了翁知兵體國，乃以端明殿學士、同僉書樞密院事督視京湖軍馬。

translations.literal: The chief ministers then said that among recent ministers only Leweng understood military affairs and grasped the state; he was made Duanming Hall Academician and Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs to oversee Jinghu armies and horses.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers then said that among recent ministers only Leweng understood military affairs and grasped the state. He was made Duanming Hall Academician and Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs to oversee Jinghu armies and horses.

sentences.zh: 會江、淮督府曾從龍以憂畏卒，並以江、淮付了翁。

translations.literal: It happened that Zeng Conglong, commissioner of the Jiang-Huai command, died of worry and fear; the Jiang and Huai regions were both entrusted to Leweng.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Zeng Conglong, commissioner of the Jiang-Huai command, died of worry and fear, and both the Jiang and Huai regions were entrusted to Leweng.

sentences.zh: 朝論大駭，以為不可，三學亦上書爭之。

translations.literal: Court debate was greatly alarmed, holding it impossible; the Three Academies also submitted memorials disputing it.
translations.idiomatic: Court debate was greatly alarmed and held it impossible. The Three Academies also submitted memorials disputing the appointment.

sentences.zh: 適邊警遝至，上心焦勞，了翁嫌於避事，既五辭弗獲，遂受命開府，宣押同二府奏事，上勉勞尤至。

translations.literal: Just then frontier alarms arrived in succession; the emperor's heart was anxious and weary; Leweng was reluctant to seem to avoid duty; having declined five times without success, he then accepted the commission and opened his command; an edict ordered him to present affairs jointly with the Two Councils; the emperor's encouragement was especially full.
translations.idiomatic: Just then frontier alarms arrived in succession and the emperor's heart was anxious and weary. Leweng was reluctant to seem to avoid duty. Having declined five times without success, he accepted the commission and opened his command. An edict ordered him to present affairs jointly with the Two Councils, and the emperor's encouragement was especially full.

sentences.zh: 尋兼提舉編修《武經要略》，恩數同執政，進封臨邛郡開國侯，又賜便宜詔書如張浚故事。

translations.literal: Soon he was concurrently put in charge of compiling Essentials of Military Classics; his honors matched those of chief ministers; he was advanced to Marquis of Linqiong Commandery and again granted discretionary edicts as in the precedent of Zhang Jun.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was concurrently put in charge of compiling Essentials of Military Classics. His honors matched those of chief ministers. He was advanced to Marquis of Linqiong Commandery and again granted discretionary edicts as in the precedent of Zhang Jun.

sentences.zh: 朝辭，麵賜禦書唐人嚴武詩及“鶴山書院”四大字，仍賜金帶鞍馬，詔宰臣飲餞於關外。

translations.literal: At court farewell he was personally granted an imperial copy of a Tang poem by Yan Wu and the four large characters "Heshan Academy," and still granted a gold belt, saddle, and horse; an edict ordered chief ministers to feast and see him off outside the pass.
translations.idiomatic: At his court farewell he was personally granted an imperial copy of a Tang poem by Yan Wu and the four large characters “Heshan Academy,” along with a gold belt, saddle, and horse. An edict ordered the chief ministers to feast and see him off outside the pass.

sentences.zh: 乃酌上下流之中，開幕府江州，申儆將帥，調遣援師，褒死事之臣，黜退懦之將，奏邊防十事。

translations.literal: He then chose the middle ground between upper and lower reaches, opened his command at Jiang Prefecture, sternly warned generals, dispatched relief armies, praised ministers who died in service, dismissed cowardly generals, and memorialized on ten frontier matters.
translations.idiomatic: He then chose the middle ground between the upper and lower reaches, opened his command at Jiang Prefecture, sternly warned the generals, dispatched relief armies, praised ministers who died in service, dismissed cowardly generals, and memorialized on ten frontier matters.

sentences.zh: 甫二旬，召為僉書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Barely twenty days later he was summoned as Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Barely twenty days later he was summoned as Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 赴闕奏事，時以疾力辭不拜。

translations.literal: Going to court to memorialize, at the time he forcefully declined on grounds of illness and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: When he went to court to memorialize, he forcefully declined on grounds of illness and did not accept.

sentences.zh: 蓋在朝諸人始謀假此命以出了翁，既出，則復以建督為非，雖恩禮赫奕，而督府奏陳動相牽製，故遽召還，前後皆非上意也。

translations.literal: For the men at court had at first plotted to use this appointment to get Leweng out; once he was out, they again held establishing the command wrong; though honors and courtesy were splendid, the command's memorials and reports were constantly constrained and checked—thus he was hastily recalled; before and after, none of this accorded with the emperor's intent.
translations.idiomatic: For the men at court had at first plotted to use this appointment to get Leweng out. Once he was out, they again held establishing the command wrong. Though honors and courtesy were splendid, the command's memorials and reports were constantly constrained and checked, so he was hastily recalled. Before and after, none of this accorded with the emperor’s intent.

sentences.zh: 尋改資政殿學士、湖南安撫使、知潭州，復力辭，詔提舉臨安府洞霄宮。

translations.literal: Soon he was changed to Zizheng Hall Academician, Hunan Pacification Commissioner, and prefect of Tan Prefecture; again he forcefully declined; an edict made him overseer of the Dongxiao Abbey in Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was changed to Zizheng Hall Academician, Hunan Pacification Commissioner, and prefect of Tan Prefecture. Again he forcefully declined, and an edict made him overseer of the Dongxiao Abbey in Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 未幾，改知紹興府、浙東安撫使。

translations.literal: Before long he was changed to prefect of Shaoxing Prefecture and Zhedong Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was changed to prefect of Shaoxing Prefecture and Zhedong Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙元年，改知福州、福建安撫使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaxi he was changed to prefect of Fuzhou and Fujian Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaxi he was changed to prefect of Fuzhou and Fujian Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 累章乞骸骨，詔不允。

translations.literal: Repeated memorials begged to retire on old age; an edict did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: Repeated memorials begged to retire on old age, but an edict did not grant it.

sentences.zh: 疾革，復上疏。

translations.literal: When his illness became critical he again submitted a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: When his illness became critical he again submitted a memorial.

sentences.zh: 門人問疾者，猶衣冠相與酬答，且曰：“吾平生處己，澹然無營。

translations.literal: Disciples who came to inquire after his illness still dressed and conversed with one another, and he said: "All my life in treating myself I have been tranquil and without striving.
translations.idiomatic: Disciples who came to inquire after his illness still dressed properly and conversed with one another, and he said, “All my life in treating myself I have been tranquil and without striving.

sentences.zh: ”復語蜀兵亂事，蹙額久之，口授遺奏，少焉拱手而逝。

translations.literal: " He again spoke of the disorder of Shu troops, knitted his brow a long while, orally dictated his final memorial, and shortly thereafter bowed with clasped hands and died.
translations.idiomatic: ” He again spoke of the disorder of Shu troops, knitted his brow a long while, orally dictated his final memorial, and shortly thereafter bowed with clasped hands and died.

sentences.zh: 後十日，詔以資政殿大學士、通奉大夫致仕。

translations.literal: Ten days later an edict made him Zizheng Hall Grand Academician and Grand Master for Appeasing the Court, retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: Ten days later an edict made him Zizheng Hall Grand Academician and Grand Master for Appeasing the Court, retired from office.

sentences.zh: 遺表聞，上震悼，輟視朝，歎惜有用才不盡之恨。

translations.literal: When his final memorial was reported the emperor was shaken and grieved; he suspended court audience and sighed with regret that useful talent had not been fully employed.
translations.idiomatic: When his final memorial was reported the emperor was shaken and grieved. He suspended court audience and sighed with regret that useful talent had not been fully employed.

sentences.zh: 詔贈太師，諡文靖，賜第宅蘇州，累贈秦國公。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously made him Grand Preceptor, posthumous name Wenjing, granted a residence in Suzhou, and repeatedly advanced to Duke of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously made him Grand Preceptor with the posthumous name Wenjing, granted a residence in Suzhou, and repeatedly advanced him to Duke of Qin.

sentences.zh: 所著有《鶴山集》、《九經要義》、《周易集義》、《易舉隅》、《周禮井田圖說》、《古今考》、《經史雜抄》、《師友雅言》。

translations.literal: His authored works include Collected Works of Heshan, Essentials of the Nine Classics, Collected Meanings of the Changes, Corners of the Changes, Diagrammatic Explanation of the Well-Field System in the Rites of Zhou, Ancient and Modern Researches, Miscellaneous Extracts from Classics and Histories, and Elegant Words of Masters and Friends.
translations.idiomatic: His authored works include Collected Works of Heshan, Essentials of the Nine Classics, Collected Meanings of the Changes, Corners of the Changes, Diagrammatic Explanation of the Well-Field System in the Rites of Zhou, Ancient and Modern Researches, Miscellaneous Extracts from Classics and Histories, and Elegant Words of Masters and Friends.

sentences.zh: 廖德明

translations.literal: Liao Deming.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Deming

sentences.zh: 廖德明，字子晦，南劍人。

translations.literal: Liao Deming, courtesy name Zihui, was a native of Nanjian.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Deming, whose courtesy name was Zihui, came from Nanjian.

sentences.zh: 少學釋氏，及得龜山楊時書，讀之大悟，遂受業朱熹。

translations.literal: In youth he studied Buddhism; when he obtained the writings of Yang Shi of Guishan and read them he greatly awakened, and then received instruction from Zhu Xi.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he studied Buddhism. When he obtained the writings of Yang Shi of Guishan and read them he greatly awakened, and then received instruction from Zhu Xi.

sentences.zh: 登乾道中進士第。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the Qiandao era.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the Qiandao era.

sentences.zh: 知莆田縣。

translations.literal: He served as magistrate of Putian County.
translations.idiomatic: He served as magistrate of Putian County.

sentences.zh: 民有奉淫祠者，罪之，沉像於江。

translations.literal: When the people worshipped illicit shrines he punished them and sank the images in the river.
translations.idiomatic: When the people worshipped illicit shrines he punished them and sank the images in the river.

sentences.zh: 會有顯者欲取邑地廣其居，德明不可，守會僚屬諭之，德明曰：“太守，天子守土之臣，未聞以土地與人者。

translations.literal: It happened that a prominent man wished to take county land to expand his residence; Deming would not allow it; the prefect convened subordinates to instruct him; Deming said: "The prefect is the Son of Heaven's minister guarding the land—I have never heard of giving land to others.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that a prominent man wished to take county land to expand his residence. Deming would not allow it. The prefect convened subordinates to instruct him, and Deming said, “The prefect is the Son of Heaven’s minister guarding the land—I have never heard of giving land to others.

sentences.zh: ”守乃慚服。

translations.literal: " The prefect then felt ashamed and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: ” The prefect then felt ashamed and submitted.

sentences.zh: 累官知潯州，有聲。

translations.literal: Through successive offices he became prefect of Xun Prefecture, with a reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Through successive offices he became prefect of Xun Prefecture and earned a reputation.

sentences.zh: 諸司且交薦之，德明曰：“今老矣，況以道徇人乎？

translations.literal: Various offices were about to jointly recommend him; Deming said: "I am old now—how could I still bend the Way to please men?
translations.idiomatic: Various offices were about to jointly recommend him. Deming said, “I am old now—how could I still bend the Way to please men?

sentences.zh: ”固辭不受。

translations.literal: " He firmly declined and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: ” He firmly declined and did not accept.

sentences.zh: 選廣東提舉刑獄，彈劾不避權要。

translations.literal: He was selected as Guangdong Judicial Intendant and in impeachment did not avoid the powerful and privileged.
translations.idiomatic: He was selected as Guangdong Judicial Intendant and in impeachment did not avoid the powerful and privileged.

sentences.zh: 歲當薦士，朝貴多以書托之，德明曰：“ 此國家公器也。

translations.literal: In the year when candidates were to be recommended, court nobles largely sent letters entrusting him; Deming said: " This is the state's public vessel.
translations.idiomatic: In the year when candidates were to be recommended, court nobles largely sent letters entrusting him. Deming said, “This is the state’s public vessel.

sentences.zh: ”悉不啟封還之。

translations.literal: " He did not open any and returned them all.
translations.idiomatic: ” He did not open any and returned them all.

sentences.zh: 有鄉人為主簿，德明聞其能，薦之。

translations.literal: A fellow townsman served as registrar; Deming heard of his ability and recommended him.
translations.idiomatic: A fellow townsman served as registrar. Deming heard of his ability and recommended him.

sentences.zh: 會德明行縣，簿感其知己，置酒延之，悉假富人觴豆甚盛。

translations.literal: When Deming was touring the county the registrar, moved by his knowing him, set out wine and invited him, borrowing entirely from the rich for vessels and dishes in great abundance.
translations.idiomatic: When Deming was touring the county the registrar, moved by his knowing him, set out wine and invited him, borrowing entirely from the rich for vessels and dishes in great abundance.

sentences.zh: 德明怒曰：“一主簿乃若是侈耶？

translations.literal: Deming angrily said: "For one registrar to be so extravagant?
translations.idiomatic: Deming angrily said, “For one registrar to be so extravagant?

sentences.zh: 必貪也。

translations.literal: He must be corrupt.
translations.idiomatic: He must be corrupt.

sentences.zh: ”於是追還薦章，其公嚴類此。

translations.literal: " He then recalled the recommendation; his public sternness was of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: ” He then recalled the recommendation. His public sternness was of this kind.

sentences.zh: 時盜陷桂陽，迫韶，韶人懼，德明燕笑自如，遣將弛擊，而親持小麾督戰，大敗之。

translations.literal: At the time bandits seized Guiyang and pressed on Shaozhou; the people of Shao were afraid; Deming feasted and laughed as usual, sent generals in swift attack, and personally held a small command baton to direct the battle, greatly defeating them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time bandits seized Guiyang and pressed on Shaozhou. The people of Shao were afraid, but Deming feasted and laughed as usual, sent generals in swift attack, and personally held a small command baton to direct the battle, greatly defeating them.

sentences.zh: 乃分戍守，遠斥堠，明審賞罰，宣布威信，韶晏然如平時。

translations.literal: He then divided garrisons to hold positions, pushed watch-posts far out, clearly examined rewards and punishments, proclaimed trust and authority, and Shaozhou was tranquil as in ordinary times.
translations.idiomatic: He then divided garrisons to hold positions, pushed watch-posts far out, clearly examined rewards and punishments, and proclaimed trust and authority. Shaozhou was tranquil as in ordinary times.

sentences.zh: 徙知廣州，遷吏部左選郎官，奉祠，卒。

translations.literal: He was transferred to prefect of Guang Prefecture, promoted to Left Selection Officer in the Ministry of Personnel, granted a sinecure, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to prefect of Guang Prefecture, promoted to Left Selection Officer in the Ministry of Personnel, granted a sinecure, and died.

sentences.zh: 德明初為潯州教授，為學者講明聖賢心學之要，手植三柏於學，潯士愛敬之如甘棠。

translations.literal: At first Deming was professor at Xun Prefecture; for scholars he expounded the essentials of the sages' learning of the heart; he personally planted three cypresses at the school, and Xun scholars loved and revered them as the sweet pear.
translations.idiomatic: At first Deming was professor at Xun Prefecture. For scholars he expounded the essentials of the sages’ learning of the heart. He personally planted three cypresses at the school, and Xun scholars loved and revered them as the sweet pear.

sentences.zh: 在南粵時，立師悟堂，刻朱熹《家禮》及程氏諸書。

translations.literal: While in the southern Yue region he established the Shiwu Hall and carved Zhu Xi's Family Rituals and the books of the Cheng school.
translations.idiomatic: While in the southern Yue region he established the Shiwu Hall and carved Zhu Xi’s Family Rituals and the books of the Cheng school.

sentences.zh: 公餘，延僚屬及諸生親為講說，遠近化之。

translations.literal: In spare time from official duties he invited subordinates and students to lecture in person; near and far were transformed by it.
translations.idiomatic: In spare time from official duties he invited subordinates and students to lecture in person, and near and far were transformed by it.

sentences.zh: 嚐語人以仕學之要曰：“德明自始仕，以至為郡，惟用三代直道而行一句而已。

translations.literal: Once he told people the essentials of office and learning, saying: "From the time Deming first entered office until serving as prefect, I used only the one phrase of the Three Dynasties—walk the straight path.
translations.idiomatic: Once he told people the essentials of office and learning, saying, “From the time Deming first entered office until serving as prefect, I used only the one phrase of the Three Dynasties—walk the straight path.

sentences.zh: ”有《槎溪集》行於世。

translations.literal: " Collected Works of Chaxi circulated in the world.
translations.idiomatic: ” Collected Works of Chaxi circulated in the world.
